    .sheet-steps-side {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .step {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      height: 100%;
      padding: 10px 12px 11px;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .step.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 9px 10px;
      background-color: #fe2c55;
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 7px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s;
    }

    .btn-primary:active {
      transform: scale(0.98);
      background-color: #e02449;
    }

    .tiktok-coin {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15));
    }

    /* STEP 1 */
    .step-1-header h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #161823;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
    }

    .step-1-header p {
      color: #ea284e;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 1px 0 5px;
    }

    .tier-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 5px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .tier-card {
      border: 1.2px solid #eaebed;
      border-radius: 7px;
      padding: 4px 2px;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      background: #f7f8f9;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 40px;
    }

    .tier-card.selected {
      border: 1.5px solid #fec400;
      background-color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(254, 196, 0, 0.4);
    }

    .tier-amount {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #161823;
      gap: 3px;
      margin-bottom: 1px;
    }

    .tier-amount.custom-text {
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .tier-price {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      color: #7b7d85;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .input-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .input-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 8px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .username-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 5px 26px 5px 26px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid #e7e8ea;
      background: #f1f2f4;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: #161823;
      outline: none;
      height: 29px;
    }

    .username-input::placeholder {
      color: #8a8b91;
    }

    .username-input:focus {
      border-color: #161823;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .search-spinner {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      right: 8px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border: 2px solid #ddd;
      border-top-color: #fe2c55;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.65s linear infinite;
    }

    .search-spinner.show {
      display: block;
    }

    .helper-text {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      color: #8a8b91;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .status-badge {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 9.5px;
      color: #606266;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .status-badge::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 11px;
      height: 11px;
      background-color: #ffb800;
      color: white;
      font-size: 7.5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      margin-right: 4px;
      font-weight: bold;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* STEP CUSTOM */
    .custom-label-top {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      color: #8a8b91;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      font-weight: 500;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .custom-back-btn {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      color: #fe2c55;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .custom-amount-box {
      border: 1px solid #e5e6e8;
      border-radius: 7px;
      background: #ffffff;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    .custom-amount-value {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #161823;
    }

    .custom-status-text {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      color: #8a8b91;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .custom-keypad-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      border: 1px solid #eaebed;
      border-radius: 7px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .key-btn {
      border: none;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-right: 1px solid #eaebed;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #eaebed;
      padding: 6px 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #161823;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.1s;
    }

    .key-btn:nth-child(3n) {
      border-right: none;
    }

    .key-btn:nth-child(n+10) {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .key-btn:active {
      background: #f1f2f4;
    }

    .backspace-icon {
      width: 15px;
      height: 15px;
    }

    /* STEP 2 */
    .secure-banner {
      background-color: #091524;
      color: #ffffff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 5.5px 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      gap: 5px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .shield-icon {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      fill: #85d7ff;
    }

    .profile-summary {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .profile-avatar {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: #111;
      border: 1px solid #e1e2e4;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .profile-info {
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .profile-info h3 {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #161823;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .profile-info p {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      color: #8a8b91;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .data-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 4.5px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f1f2;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .data-label {
      color: #76777e;
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .data-val {
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #161823;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .radio-circle {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border: 2px solid #fe2c55;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .radio-circle::after {
      content: "";
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: #fe2c55;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    /* STEP 3 */
    #step-3 {
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .spinner {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border: 3.5px solid #eceef1;
      border-top-color: #fe2c55;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    .loading-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #161823;
    }

    /* STEP 4 */
    #step-4 {
      text-align: center;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .check-icon-large {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      stroke: #22c55e;
      margin: 2px 0 4px;
    }

    .success-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #161823;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .assigned-info {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #161823;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      font-weight: 600;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .estimated-date {
      color: #ea284e;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .sub-notice {
      color: #7b7d85;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="container">
    
    <!-- HEADER STREAM -->
    <div class="stream-header" id="streamContainer">
      <video class="stream-video" autoplay loop muted playsinline disablePictureInPicture id="manualStreamVideo">
        <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
        <source src="https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-vertical-portrait-of-a-woman-posing-with-colorful-lights-42999-large.mp4" type="video/mp4">
      </video>

      <!-- Frame YouTube -->
      <iframe class="yt-stream-frame" id="ytStreamFrame" src="" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>

      <!-- Overlay Layar Hitam -->
      <div class="video-blackout" id="videoBlackout">
        <span style="font-size: 26px;">📷🚫</span>
        <span>Video Dinonaktifkan</span>
      </div>

      <input type="file" id="galleryInput" accept="video/*,image/*" style="display: none;">
      <input type="file" id="nativeCameraInput" accept="video/*,image/*" capture="environment" style="display: none;">
      <input type="file" id="musicGalleryInput" accept="audio/*,video/*" style="display: none;">
      <audio id="bgAudio" loop playsinline></audio>

      <!-- Notifikasi Mini Status Lagu -->
      <div class="music-status-bar" id="musicStatusBar">
        <span id="statusBarIcon">🎵</span>
        <span class="music-status-text" id="musicPlayingTitle">Memutar Lagu</span>
        <span class="btn-stop-mini" id="btnStopMusicMini" title="Tutup">&#x2715;</span>
      </div>

      <!-- Tombol Aksi Kanan Atas -->
      <div class="top-actions">
        <!-- 1. Fullscreen -->
        <button class="action-circle-btn" id="btnToggleFullscreen" title="Layar Penuh">
          <svg id="iconEnterFullscreen" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><polyline points="15 3 21 3 21 9"></polyline><polyline points="9 21 3 21 3 15"></polyline><line x1="21" y1="3" x2="14" y2="10"></line><line x1="3" y1="21" x2="10" y2="14"></line></svg>
          <svg id="iconExitFullscreen" style="display: none;" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><polyline points="4 14 10 14 10 20"></polyline><polyline points="20 10 14 10 14 4"></polyline><line x1="14" y1="10" x2="21" y2="3"></line><line x1="3" y1="21" x2="10" y2="14"></line></svg>
        </button>

        <!-- 2. Suara -->
        <button class="action-circle-btn" id="btnToggleVideoSound" title="Suara Video">
          <svg id="iconSoundMute" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"></line><path d="M9 9v3a3 3 0 0 0 5.12 2.12M15 9.34V4a3 3 0 0 0-5.94-.6"></path><path d="M17 16.95A7 7 0 0 1 5 12v-2m14 0v2a7 7 0 0 1-.11 1.23"></path><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="23"></line><line x1="8" y1="23" x2="16" y2="23"></line></svg>
          <svg id="iconSoundOn" style="display: none;" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon><path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"></path></svg>
        </button>

        <!-- 3. Kamera On/Off -->
        <button class="action-circle-btn" id="btnToggleVideoPower" title="Video On/Off">
          <svg id="iconCamOn" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M23 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2-3h6l2 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="4"></circle></svg>
          <svg id="iconCamOff" style="display: none;" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><line x1="2" y1="2" x2="22" y2="22"></line><path d="M10.41 10.41a4 4 0 0 0 5.18 5.18"></path><path d="M7 7H3a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v10a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16c.39 0 .76-.11 1.07-.31"></path><path d="M23 19V8a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-4l-2-3h-4.3"></path></svg>
        </button>

        <!-- 4. Sumber Video -->
        <button class="action-circle-btn" id="btnOpenSourceModal" title="Sumber Video">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10"></polyline><polyline points="1 20 1 14 7 14"></polyline><path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"></path></svg>
        </button>

        <!-- 5. Musik/YouTube -->
        <button class="action-circle-btn" id="btnOpenMusicModal" title="Putar Musik YouTube">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"></path><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"></circle><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"></circle></svg>
        </button>
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- MODAL PILIHAN KAMERA -->
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="cameraModalBackdrop">
      <div class="modal-content">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <h3>📹 Sumber Kamera & Video</h3>
          <span class="close-modal-btn" id="btnCloseCameraModal">&times;</span>
        </div>

        <div class="source-options-list">
          <div class="source-option-card" id="btnOpenYtFromCamera">
            <div class="source-icon">📺</div>
            <div class="source-info">
              <h4>Video & Musik YouTube (Link)</h4>
              <p>Putar video + musik lewat link YouTube atau Shorts</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="source-option-card card-toggle-power" id="btnModalTogglePower">
            <div class="source-icon" id="modalPowerIcon">🛑</div>
            <div class="source-info">
              <h4 id="modalPowerTitle">Matikan Video (Layar Gelap)</h4>
              <p id="modalPowerDesc">Klik untuk mematikan tampilan video/kamera</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="source-option-card" onclick="startLiveCamera('user')">
            <div class="source-icon">🤳</div>
            <div class="source-info">
              <h4>Kamera Depan / Selfie</h4>
              <p>Live stream kamera selfie bawaan secara real-time</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="source-option-card" onclick="startLiveCamera('environment')">
            <div class="source-icon">📷</div>
            <div class="source-info">
              <h4>Kamera Belakang (Live Cam)</h4>
              <p>Live stream kamera utama HP secara real-time</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="source-option-card" id="btnOpenNativeCamera">
            <div class="source-icon">📸</div>
            <div class="source-info">
              <h4>Ambil Rekaman Kamera HP</h4>
              <p>Buka kamera HP untuk rekam video/foto baru</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="source-option-card" id="btnTriggerGalleryFile">
            <div class="source-icon">📁</div>
            <div class="source-info">
              <h4>Pilih dari Galeri / File</h4>
              <p>Pilih file video atau foto yang tersimpan di HP</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MODAL YOUTUBE & AUDIO -->
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="musicModalBackdrop">
      <div class="modal-content">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <h3>📺 Putar Video & Musik YouTube</h3>
          <span class="close-modal-btn" id="btnCloseMusicModal">&times;</span>
        </div>

        <div class="music-tab-group">
          <button type="button" class="music-tab-btn active" id="tabBtnYoutube">Link / Cari YouTube</button>
          <button type="button" class="music-tab-btn" id="tabBtnGallery">Galeri / File HP</button>
        </div>

        <div class="tab-content active" id="tabContentYoutube">
          <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #9ca3af; margin-bottom: 2px;">
            Tempel link video YouTube, Shorts, atau ketik judul:
          </div>
          <div class="yt-search-input-wrap">
            <input type="text" id="ytQueryInput" class="yt-search-input" placeholder="https://youtube.com/watch?v=... / Shorts">
            <button type="button" class="btn-yt-go" id="btnPlayYoutube">Putar</button>
          </div>

          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 4px;">
            <span style="font-size: 11px; color: #8a8b91;">Ukuran Tampilan:</span>
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 5px;">
              <button type="button" class="yt-scale-pill active" id="btnScaleCover" onclick="changeYtScale('cover')">🔥 Penuh (No Black Bar)</button>
              <button type="button" class="yt-scale-pill" id="btnScaleFit" onclick="changeYtScale('fit')">⏹️ Pas (Fit)</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #8a8b91; margin-top: 6px;">Pilihan Cepat Video Viral:</div>
          <div class="yt-presets">
            <span class="preset-pill" onclick="quickPlayYt('DJ TikTok Viral 2024')">🔥 DJ TikTok Viral</span>
            <span class="preset-pill" onclick="quickPlayYt('Jedag Jedug Bass TikTok')">⚡ Jedag Jedug</span>
            <span class="preset-pill" onclick="quickPlayYt('Chill Lofi TikTok Beat')">☕ Lofi Chill</span>
            <span class="preset-pill" onclick="quickPlayYt('Acoustic Viral TikTok')">🎸 Akustik Pop</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="tab-content" id="tabContentGallery">
          <button type="button" class="btn-pick-gallery" id="btnTriggerMusicFile">
            📁 Buka Galeri & Pilih Lagu (MP3/Audio)
          </button>
          <p style="font-size: 11px; color: #8a8b91; text-align: center; margin-top: 4px;">
            Mendukung file musik MP3, M4A, WAV, dan video dari perangkat Anda.
          </p>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SHEET BAWAH: DUA BAGIAN (KIRI DATA TARGET, KANAN ISI ULANG KOIN) -->
    <div class="sheet-card">

      <!-- BAGIAN KIRI: DATA TARGET & FOTO PROFIL -->
      <div class="sheet-target-side">
        <div class="target-side-top">
          <span class="target-side-label">Data Target</span>
          <img id="sheetTargetAvatar" class="target-side-avatar" src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="Target Profile" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
          <div class="target-side-name" id="sheetTargetName">username</div>
          <div class="target-side-handle" id="sheetTargetHandle">@username</div>
          <div class="target-side-stats" id="sheetTargetStats"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="target-side-bottom">
          <div class="target-coin-box">
            <div class="target-coin-row">
              <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
              <span id="sheetTargetCoins">30 Coins</span>
            </div>
            <div class="target-coin-price" id="sheetTargetPrice">$0.31</div>
          </div>
          <div class="target-live-pill">
            <span class="target-live-dot"></span>
            <span id="sheetTargetStatus">Target Aktif</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- BAGIAN KANAN: ISI ULANG KOIN -->
      <div class="sheet-steps-side">

        <!-- STEP 1 -->
        <div class="step active" id="step-1">
          <div>
            <div class="step-1-header">
              <h2>Select Tier</h2>
              <p>Includes 31% extra tier level bonus.</p>
            </div>

            <div class="tier-grid">
              <div class="tier-card selected" data-tier="30 Coins" data-coins="30" data-price="$0.31">
                <div class="tier-amount">
                  <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
                  <span>30</span>
                </div>
                <div class="tier-price">$0.31</div>
              </div>

              <div class="tier-card" data-tier="350 Coins" data-coins="350" data-price="$3.65">
                <div class="tier-amount">
                  <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
                  <span>350</span>
                </div>
                <div class="tier-price">$3.65</div>
              </div>

              <div class="tier-card" data-tier="700 Coins" data-coins="700" data-price="$7.25">
                <div class="tier-amount">
                  <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
                  <span>700</span>
                </div>
                <div class="tier-price">$7.25</div>
              </div>

              <div class="tier-card" data-tier="1400 Coins" data-coins="1400" data-price="$14.49">
                <div class="tier-amount">
                  <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
                  <span>1400</span>
                </div>
                <div class="tier-price">$14.49</div>
              </div>

              <div class="tier-card" data-tier="3500 Coins" data-coins="3500" data-price="$36.2">
                <div class="tier-amount">
                  <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
                  <span>3500</span>
                </div>
                <div class="tier-price">$36.2</div>
              </div>

              <div class="tier-card" id="cardCustomTier" data-tier="Custom" data-coins="Custom" data-price="Amount">
                <div class="tier-amount custom-text">
                  <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
                  <span>Custom</span>
                </div>
                <div class="tier-price">Amount</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="input-wrapper">
              <span class="input-icon">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" fill="#7b61ff"><path d="M12 12c2.67 0 4.8-2.13 4.8-4.8S14.67 2.4 12 2.4 7.2 4.53 7.2 7.2 9.33 12 12 12zm0 2.4c-3.2 0-9.6 1.6-9.6 4.8v2.4h19.2v-2.4c0-3.2-6.4-4.8-9.6-4.8z"/></svg>
              </span>
              <input type="text" id="usernameInput" class="username-input" placeholder="Type @username" value="" autocomplete="off">
              <span id="searchSpinner" class="search-spinner"></span>
            </div>

            <p class="helper-text" id="lookupHelper">Showing @username. Type 3+ letters to look up another.</p>
            <div class="status-badge">Limited time entry window active</div>
          </div>

          <button class="btn-primary" id="btn-confirm-tier">Confirm 30 Coins</button>
        </div>

        <!-- STEP CUSTOM -->
        <div class="step" id="step-custom">
          <div>
            <div class="custom-label-top">
              <span>Amount</span>
              <span class="custom-back-btn" id="btnBackFromCustom">&larr; Back</span>
            </div>

            <div class="custom-amount-box">
              <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
              <span class="custom-amount-value" id="customAmountDisplay">0</span>
            </div>

            <div class="custom-status-text">Rank status: Custom Tier</div>

            <div class="custom-keypad-grid">
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('1')">1</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('2')">2</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('3')">3</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('4')">4</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('5')">5</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('6')">6</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('7')">7</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('8')">8</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('9')">9</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKeyBackspace()">
                <svg class="backspace-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 4H8l-7 8 7 8h13a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2z"></path><line x1="18" y1="9" x2="12" y2="15"></line><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="18" y2="15"></line></svg>
              </button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('0')">0</button>
              <button type="button" class="key-btn" onclick="pressCustomKey('000')">000</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button class="btn-primary" id="btnNextCustom">Next</button>
        </div>

        <!-- STEP 2 -->
        <div class="step" id="step-2">
          <div>
            <div class="secure-banner">
              <svg class="shield-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 1L3 5v6c0 5.55 3.84 10.74 9 12 5.16-1.26 9-6.45 9-12V5l-9-4z"/></svg>
              <span>Secure routing active</span>
            </div>

            <div class="profile-summary">
              <img id="targetAvatar" class="profile-avatar" src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="Profile" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
              <div class="profile-info">
                <h3 id="display-name">username</h3>
                <p id="display-handle">@username</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="data-row">
              <span class="data-label">Target Account</span>
              <span class="data-val" id="summary-target">username</span>
            </div>

            <div class="data-row">
              <span class="data-val">
                <svg class="tiktok-coin" style="margin-right:4px;" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
                <span id="summary-coins">30</span>
              </span>
              <span class="data-label" id="summary-tier-name">$0.31</span>
            </div>

            <div class="data-row">
              <span class="data-label">Server Cluster Alpha</span>
              <span style="color: #b0b1b5; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1;">&rsaquo;</span>
            </div>

            <div class="data-row">
              <span class="data-label">Direct Pipeline</span>
              <span class="radio-circle"></span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button class="btn-primary" id="btn-complete-allocation">Complete Allocation</button>
        </div>

        <!-- STEP 3 -->
        <div class="step" id="step-3">
          <div class="spinner"></div>
          <div class="loading-text">Allocating package...</div>
        </div>

        <!-- STEP 4 -->
        <div class="step" id="step-4">
          <div>
            <svg class="check-icon-large" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="3.5">
              <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
            </svg>

            <h2 class="success-title">Allocation Successful!</h2>

            <div class="assigned-info">
              <svg class="tiktok-coin" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="18" fill="#ffd426" stroke="#ffe870" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="20" cy="20" r="14.5" fill="#fdb800"/><path d="M22 13c1.3 1.5 2.9 2.2 4.6 2.3v2.3c-1.8-.1-3.3-.8-4.6-1.9v7.5a4.2 4.2 0 1 1-3.9-4.2 4.3 4.3 0 0 1 1.9.4v2.4a2 2 0 1 0 2 1.9V13h0z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>
              <span><span id="success-coins">30</span> assigned to <span id="success-user">@username</span>.</span>
            </div>

            <p class="estimated-date">Estimated Delivery: Instant / Today</p>
            <p class="sub-notice">This action is finished.<br>Update will reflect soon.</p>
          </div>

          <button class="btn-primary" id="btn-accept">Accept</button>
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

  <script>
    /* 1. KONTROL SUARA, KAMERA, YOUTUBE & FULLSCREEN */
    const videoElem = document.getElementById('manualStreamVideo');
    const streamContainer = document.getElementById('streamContainer');
    const ytStreamFrame = document.getElementById('ytStreamFrame');
    const videoBlackout = document.getElementById('videoBlackout');
    const containerElem = document.querySelector('.container');

    const btnToggleFullscreen = document.getElementById('btnToggleFullscreen');
    const iconEnterFullscreen = document.getElementById('iconEnterFullscreen');
    const iconExitFullscreen = document.getElementById('iconExitFullscreen');

    const btnToggleVideoSound = document.getElementById('btnToggleVideoSound');
    const iconSoundMute = document.getElementById('iconSoundMute');
    const iconSoundOn = document.getElementById('iconSoundOn');

    const btnToggleVideoPower = document.getElementById('btnToggleVideoPower');
    const iconCamOn = document.getElementById('iconCamOn');
    const iconCamOff = document.getElementById('iconCamOff');

    const btnModalTogglePower = document.getElementById('btnModalTogglePower');
    const modalPowerIcon = document.getElementById('modalPowerIcon');
    const modalPowerTitle = document.getElementById('modalPowerTitle');
    const modalPowerDesc = document.getElementById('modalPowerDesc');
    const btnOpenYtFromCamera = document.getElementById('btnOpenYtFromCamera');

    const btnOpenSourceModal = document.getElementById('btnOpenSourceModal');
    const cameraModalBackdrop = document.getElementById('cameraModalBackdrop');
    const btnCloseCameraModal = document.getElementById('btnCloseCameraModal');
    const btnOpenNativeCamera = document.getElementById('btnOpenNativeCamera');
    const btnTriggerGalleryFile = document.getElementById('btnTriggerGalleryFile');

    const galleryInput = document.getElementById('galleryInput');
    const nativeCameraInput = document.getElementById('nativeCameraInput');

    const btnOpenMusicModal = document.getElementById('btnOpenMusicModal');
    const musicModalBackdrop = document.getElementById('musicModalBackdrop');
    const btnCloseMusicModal = document.getElementById('btnCloseMusicModal');
    const tabBtnYoutube = document.getElementById('tabBtnYoutube');
    const tabBtnGallery = document.getElementById('tabBtnGallery');
    const tabContentYoutube = document.getElementById('tabContentYoutube');
    const tabContentGallery = document.getElementById('tabContentGallery');

    const ytQueryInput = document.getElementById('ytQueryInput');
    const btnPlayYoutube = document.getElementById('btnPlayYoutube');

    const btnTriggerMusicFile = document.getElementById('btnTriggerMusicFile');
    const musicGalleryInput = document.getElementById('musicGalleryInput');
    const bgAudio = document.getElementById('bgAudio');

    const musicStatusBar = document.getElementById('musicStatusBar');
    const statusBarIcon = document.getElementById('statusBarIcon');
    const musicPlayingTitle = document.getElementById('musicPlayingTitle');
    const btnStopMusicMini = document.getElementById('btnStopMusicMini');

    let isVideoRunning = true;
    let isVideoAudioUnmuted = false;
    let isYouTubeActive = false;
    let activeCameraStream = null;
    let currentYtScaleMode = 'cover';

    function stopActiveCameraStream() {
      if (activeCameraStream) {
        activeCameraStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
        activeCameraStream = null;
      }
    }

    function postYtCommand(funcName, args = []) {
      if (ytStreamFrame && ytStreamFrame.contentWindow) {
        ytStreamFrame.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify({
          event: 'command',
          func: funcName,
          args: args
        }), '*');
      }
    }

    window.changeYtScale = function(mode) {
      currentYtScaleMode = mode;
      const btnCover = document.getElementById('btnScaleCover');
      const btnFit = document.getElementById('btnScaleFit');
      if (btnCover && btnFit) {
        btnCover.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'cover');
        btnFit.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'fit');
      }
      applyYtScale();
    };

    function applyYtScale() {
      if (currentYtScaleMode === 'cover') {
        ytStreamFrame.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(2.7)';
      } else {
        ytStreamFrame.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.0)';
      }
    }

    function toggleFullscreen() {
      if (!document.fullscreenElement && !document.webkitFullscreenElement) {
        if (containerElem.requestFullscreen) {
          containerElem.requestFullscreen();
        } else if (containerElem.webkitRequestFullscreen) {
          containerElem.webkitRequestFullscreen();
        }
      } else {
        if (document.exitFullscreen) {
          document.exitFullscreen();
        } else if (document.webkitExitFullscreen) {
          document.webkitExitFullscreen();
        }
      }
    }

    function updateFullscreenIcons() {
      const isFS = !!(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement);
      if (isFS) {
        iconEnterFullscreen.style.display = 'none';
        iconExitFullscreen.style.display = 'block';
        btnToggleFullscreen.title = "Keluar Layar Penuh";
      } else {
        iconEnterFullscreen.style.display = 'block';
        iconExitFullscreen.style.display = 'none';
        btnToggleFullscreen.title = "Layar Penuh";
      }
    }

    btnToggleFullscreen.addEventListener('click', toggleFullscreen);
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', updateFullscreenIcons);
    document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', updateFullscreenIcons);

    function setVideoSoundState(unmute) {
      isVideoAudioUnmuted = unmute;
      videoElem.muted = !unmute;

      if (isYouTubeActive) {
        postYtCommand(unmute ? 'unMute' : 'mute');
      }

      if (unmute) {
        videoElem.volume = 1.0;
        btnToggleVideoSound.classList.add('sound-unmuted');
        btnToggleVideoSound.title = "Matikan Suara Video";
        iconSoundMute.style.display = 'none';
        iconSoundOn.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        btnToggleVideoSound.classList.remove('sound-unmuted');
        btnToggleVideoSound.title = "Nyalakan Suara Video";
        iconSoundMute.style.display = 'block';
        iconSoundOn.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    btnToggleVideoSound.addEventListener('click', () => {
      setVideoSoundState(!isVideoAudioUnmuted);
    });

    function setVideoPowerState(turnOn) {
      isVideoRunning = turnOn;
      const streamImg = document.getElementById('uploadedStreamImg');

      if (turnOn) {
        videoBlackout.classList.remove('active');

        if (isYouTubeActive) {
          ytStreamFrame.classList.add('active');
          postYtCommand('playVideo');
        } else if (streamImg) {
          streamImg.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          videoElem.style.display = 'block';
          videoElem.play().catch(() => {});
        }

        btnToggleVideoPower.classList.remove('video-state-off');
        iconCamOn.style.display = 'block';
        iconCamOff.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        videoBlackout.classList.add('active');

        if (isYouTubeActive) {
          postYtCommand('pauseVideo');
        }

        videoElem.pause();
        videoElem.style.display = 'none';
        if (streamImg) streamImg.style.display = 'none';

        btnToggleVideoPower.classList.add('video-state-off');
        iconCamOn.style.display = 'none';
        iconCamOff.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }

    btnToggleVideoPower.addEventListener('click', () => {
      setVideoPowerState(!isVideoRunning);
    });

    btnModalTogglePower.addEventListener('click', () => {
      setVideoPowerState(!isVideoRunning);
      cameraModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
    });

    btnOpenYtFromCamera.addEventListener('click', () => {
      cameraModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
      musicModalBackdrop.classList.add('show');
      tabBtnYoutube.click();
    });

    /* 2. PEMUTAR YOUTUBE TANPA JEDA (CONTINUOUS LOOP) */
    function extractYouTubeId(url) {
      if (!url) return null;
      const trimmed = url.trim();
      const regExp = /(?:youtu\.be\/|youtube\.com\/(?:embed\/|v\/|watch\?v=|watch\?.+&v=|shorts\/|live\/))([\w-]{11})/;
      const match = trimmed.match(regExp);
      if (match && match[1]) {
        return match[1];
      }
      if (/^[\w-]{11}$/.test(trimmed)) {
        return trimmed;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function playYouTubeVideoAndMusic(queryOrUrl) {
      if (!queryOrUrl || !queryOrUrl.trim()) return;

      const trimmed = queryOrUrl.trim();
      const videoId = extractYouTubeId(trimmed);

      stopActiveCameraStream();
      videoElem.pause();
      videoElem.style.display = 'none';

      const existingImg = document.getElementById('uploadedStreamImg');
      if (existingImg) existingImg.remove();

      if (bgAudio) {
        bgAudio.pause();
        bgAudio.currentTime = 0;
      }

      /* Parameter loop=1 & playlist=videoId memastikan video tidak terhenti/jeda */
      let embedUrl = "";
      if (videoId) {
        embedUrl = `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}?autoplay=1&mute=0&controls=0&playsinline=1&loop=1&playlist=${videoId}&enablejsapi=1&origin=${encodeURIComponent(location.origin || '*')}`;
      } else {
        embedUrl = `https://www.youtube.com/embed?listType=search&list=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}&autoplay=1&mute=0&controls=0&playsinline=1&enablejsapi=1&origin=${encodeURIComponent(location.origin || '*')}`;
      }

      ytStreamFrame.src = embedUrl;
      ytStreamFrame.classList.add('active');
      isYouTubeActive = true;
      applyYtScale();

      setVideoPowerState(true);
      setVideoSoundState(true);

      btnOpenMusicModal.classList.add('music-playing');
      musicModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
    }

    btnPlayYoutube.addEventListener('click', () => {
      playYouTubeVideoAndMusic(ytQueryInput.value);
    });

    ytQueryInput.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        playYouTubeVideoAndMusic(ytQueryInput.value);
      }
    });

    window.quickPlayYt = function(keyword) {
      ytQueryInput.value = keyword;
      playYouTubeVideoAndMusic(keyword);
    };

    btnOpenSourceModal.addEventListener('click', () => cameraModalBackdrop.classList.add('show'));
    btnCloseCameraModal.addEventListener('click', () => cameraModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show'));
    cameraModalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === cameraModalBackdrop) cameraModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show'); });

    btnOpenMusicModal.addEventListener('click', () => musicModalBackdrop.classList.add('show'));
    btnCloseMusicModal.addEventListener('click', () => musicModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show'));
    musicModalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === musicModalBackdrop) musicModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show'); });

    tabBtnYoutube.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabBtnYoutube.classList.add('active');
      tabBtnGallery.classList.remove('active');
      tabContentYoutube.classList.add('active');
      tabContentGallery.classList.remove('active');
    });

    tabBtnGallery.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabBtnGallery.classList.add('active');
      tabBtnYoutube.classList.remove('active');
      tabContentGallery.classList.add('active');
      tabContentYoutube.classList.remove('active');
    });

    function stopAllMusic() {
      if (bgAudio) {
        bgAudio.pause();
        bgAudio.currentTime = 0;
      }
      if (isYouTubeActive) {
        ytStreamFrame.src = "";
        ytStreamFrame.classList.remove('active');
        isYouTubeActive = false;
        videoElem.style.display = 'block';
        videoElem.play().catch(() => {});
      }
      btnOpenMusicModal.classList.remove('music-playing');
      musicStatusBar.classList.remove('show');
    }

    btnStopMusicMini.addEventListener('click', () => {
      stopAllMusic();
    });

    window.startLiveCamera = async function(facingMode) {
      stopActiveCameraStream();
      if (isYouTubeActive) {
        ytStreamFrame.src = "";
        ytStreamFrame.classList.remove('active');
        isYouTubeActive = false;
      }
      const existingImg = document.getElementById('uploadedStreamImg');
      if (existingImg) existingImg.remove();

      videoElem.style.display = 'block';
      videoElem.src = '';

      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: facingMode, width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 } },
          audio: false
        });
        activeCameraStream = stream;
        videoElem.srcObject = stream;
        videoElem.play();
        setVideoPowerState(true);
        cameraModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
      } catch (err) {
        alert('Gagal mengakses kamera: ' + err.message);
      }
    };

    btnOpenNativeCamera.addEventListener('click', () => {
      cameraModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
      nativeCameraInput.click();
    });

    nativeCameraInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => handlePickedMedia(e.target.files[0]));
    btnTriggerGalleryFile.addEventListener('click', () => {
      cameraModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
      galleryInput.click();
    });
    galleryInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => handlePickedMedia(e.target.files[0]));

    function handlePickedMedia(file) {
      if (!file) return;
      stopActiveCameraStream();
      if (isYouTubeActive) {
        ytStreamFrame.src = "";
        ytStreamFrame.classList.remove('active');
        isYouTubeActive = false;
      }
      videoElem.srcObject = null;
      const mediaUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

      if (file.type.startsWith('video/')) {
        const existingImg = document.getElementById('uploadedStreamImg');
        if (existingImg) existingImg.remove();
        videoElem.style.display = 'block';
        videoElem.src = mediaUrl;
        videoElem.load();
        setVideoSoundState(true);
        videoElem.play().catch(() => {});
      } else if (file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        videoElem.pause();
        videoElem.style.display = 'none';
        let streamImg = document.getElementById('uploadedStreamImg');
        if (!streamImg) {
          streamImg = document.createElement('img');
          streamImg.id = 'uploadedStreamImg';
          streamImg.className = 'stream-media-img';
          streamContainer.insertBefore(streamImg, streamContainer.firstChild);
        }
        streamImg.src = mediaUrl;
        streamImg.style.display = 'block';
      }
      setVideoPowerState(true);
    }

    btnTriggerMusicFile.addEventListener('click', () => musicGalleryInput.click());
    musicGalleryInput.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
      const file = event.target.files[0];
      if (!file) return;

      if (isYouTubeActive) {
        ytStreamFrame.src = "";
        ytStreamFrame.classList.remove('active');
        isYouTubeActive = false;
        videoElem.style.display = 'block';
        videoElem.play().catch(() => {});
      }

      const audioUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      bgAudio.src = audioUrl;
      bgAudio.load();
      bgAudio.play().then(() => {
        btnOpenMusicModal.classList.add('music-playing');
        statusBarIcon.textContent = "🎵";
        musicPlayingTitle.textContent = file.name;
        musicStatusBar.classList.add('show');
        musicModalBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
      }).catch(() => {});
    });

    if (videoElem) {
      videoElem.muted = true;
      videoElem.play().catch(() => {});
    }

    /* 3. TIKTOK LOGIC & STEPS */
    const INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME = 'username';
    const defaultAvatar = "https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png";

    let selectedCoins = "30";
    let selectedTier = "30 Coins";
    let selectedPrice = "$0.31";

    let currentAccount = {
      username: INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME,
      name: INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME,
      avatar: defaultAvatar,
      followers: null,
      likes: null
    };

    const step1 = document.getElementById('step-1');
    const stepCustom = document.getElementById('step-custom');
    const step2 = document.getElementById('step-2');
    const step3 = document.getElementById('step-3');
    const step4 = document.getElementById('step-4');

    const tierCards = document.querySelectorAll('.tier-card');
    const cardCustomTier = document.getElementById('cardCustomTier');
    const btnConfirmTier = document.getElementById('btn-confirm-tier');
    const usernameInput = document.getElementById('usernameInput');
    const searchSpinner = document.getElementById('searchSpinner');
    const lookupHelper = document.getElementById('lookupHelper');

    const customAmountDisplay = document.getElementById('customAmountDisplay');
    const btnBackFromCustom = document.getElementById('btnBackFromCustom');
    const btnNextCustom = document.getElementById('btnNextCustom');

    const targetAvatar = document.getElementById('targetAvatar');
    const displayName = document.getElementById('display-name');
    const displayHandle = document.getElementById('display-handle');
    const summaryTarget = document.getElementById('summary-target');
    const summaryCoins = document.getElementById('summary-coins');
    const summaryTierName = document.getElementById('summary-tier-name');

    const sheetTargetAvatar = document.getElementById('sheetTargetAvatar');
    const sheetTargetName = document.getElementById('sheetTargetName');
    const sheetTargetHandle = document.getElementById('sheetTargetHandle');
    const sheetTargetStats = document.getElementById('sheetTargetStats');
    const sheetTargetCoins = document.getElementById('sheetTargetCoins');
    const sheetTargetPrice = document.getElementById('sheetTargetPrice');
    const sheetTargetStatus = document.getElementById('sheetTargetStatus');

    const btnCompleteAllocation = document.getElementById('btn-complete-allocation');
    const successCoins = document.getElementById('success-coins');
    const successUser = document.getElementById('success-user');
    const btnAccept = document.getElementById('btn-accept');

    targetAvatar.onerror = function() {
      this.onerror = null;
      this.src = defaultAvatar;
    };

    sheetTargetAvatar.onerror = function() {
      this.onerror = null;
      this.src = defaultAvatar;
    };

    function formatCompactNumber(num) {
      const n = Number(num);
      if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return '';
      if (n >= 1000000) return (n / 1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M';
      if (n >= 1000) return (n / 1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';
      return String(n);
    }

    function updateTargetSide(statusText) {
      const uname = currentAccount.username || INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME;
      const dname = currentAccount.name || uname;

      sheetTargetAvatar.src = currentAccount.avatar || defaultAvatar;
      sheetTargetName.textContent = dname;
      sheetTargetHandle.textContent = `@${uname}`;
      sheetTargetCoins.textContent = `${selectedCoins} Coins`;
      sheetTargetPrice.textContent = selectedPrice;

      if (statusText) {
        sheetTargetStatus.textContent = statusText;
      }

      const fStr = formatCompactNumber(currentAccount.followers);
      const lStr = formatCompactNumber(currentAccount.likes);
      if (fStr || lStr) {
        const lines = [];
        if (fStr) lines.push(`👥 ${fStr}`);
        if (lStr) lines.push(`❤️ ${lStr}`);
        sheetTargetStats.textContent = lines.join(' • ');
        sheetTargetStats.classList.add('show');
      } else {
        sheetTargetStats.textContent = '';
        sheetTargetStats.classList.remove('show');
      }
    }

    let detectTimer = null;
    let requestId = 0;

    function normalizeUsername(str) {
      return String(str || '').trim().replace(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.|m\.)?tiktok\.com\/@?/i, '').replace(/^@/, '').split(/[/?#]/)[0];
    }

    function fetchTikTokProfile(username) {
      const cleanUser = normalizeUsername(username);
      if (!cleanUser || cleanUser === INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME) return;

      const currentReq = ++requestId;
      searchSpinner.classList.add('show');
      updateTargetSide('Mencari...');

      fetch('https://www.tikwm.com/api/user/info/', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: 'unique_id=' + encodeURIComponent(cleanUser)
      })
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(json => {
        if (currentReq !== requestId) return;
        searchSpinner.classList.remove('show');

        if (json.code === 0 && json.data) {
          const u = json.data.user || {};
          const s = json.data.stats || {};
          currentAccount = {
            username: u.uniqueId || cleanUser,
            name: u.nickname || cleanUser,
            avatar: u.avatarLarger || u.avatarThumb || defaultAvatar,
            followers: s.followerCount ?? null,
            likes: s.heartCount ?? null
          };
          lookupHelper.textContent = `Showing @${currentAccount.username}. Type 3+ letters to look up another.`;
          updateTargetSide('Terverifikasi');
        } else {
          currentAccount = { username: cleanUser, name: cleanUser, avatar: defaultAvatar, followers: null, likes: null };
          lookupHelper.textContent = `Showing @${cleanUser}. Type 3+ letters to look up another.`;
          updateTargetSide('Target Aktif');
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (currentReq !== requestId) return;
        searchSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        currentAccount = { username: cleanUser, name: cleanUser, avatar: defaultAvatar, followers: null, likes: null };
        updateTargetSide('Target Aktif');
      });
    }

    usernameInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
      clearTimeout(detectTimer);
      const val = normalizeUsername(usernameInput.value);

      if (val.length > 0) {
        currentAccount = { username: val, name: val, avatar: defaultAvatar, followers: null, likes: null };
        lookupHelper.textContent = `Showing @${val}. Type 3+ letters to look up another.`;
        updateTargetSide('Target Aktif');

        if (val.length >= 3) {
          detectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            fetchTikTokProfile(val);
          }, 500);
        } else {
          searchSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        }
      } else {
        searchSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        currentAccount = { username: INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME, name: INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME, avatar: defaultAvatar, followers: null, likes: null };
        lookupHelper.textContent = "Showing @username. Type 3+ letters to look up another.";
        updateTargetSide('Target Aktif');
      }
    });

    /* 4. KEYPAD CUSTOM */
    let customAmountStr = "0";

    function updateCustomDisplay() {
      customAmountDisplay.textContent = customAmountStr;
      if (stepCustom.classList.contains('active')) {
        const previewCoins = parseInt(customAmountStr) > 0 ? customAmountStr : "0";
        selectedCoins = previewCoins;
        selectedTier = "Custom Tier";
        selectedPrice = "$" + (parseInt(previewCoins) * 0.0105).toFixed(2);
        updateTargetSide();
      }
    }

    function pressCustomKey(val) {
      if (customAmountStr.length >= 8) return;
      if (val === "000") {
        if (customAmountStr !== "0") customAmountStr += "000";
      } else if (val === "0") {
        if (customAmountStr !== "0") customAmountStr += "0";
      } else {
        if (customAmountStr === "0") customAmountStr = val;
        else customAmountStr += val;
      }
      updateCustomDisplay();
    }

    function pressCustomKeyBackspace() {
      if (customAmountStr.length <= 1) customAmountStr = "0";
      else customAmountStr = customAmountStr.slice(0, -1);
      updateCustomDisplay();
    }

    cardCustomTier.addEventListener('click', () => {
      step1.classList.remove('active');
      stepCustom.classList.add('active');
      updateCustomDisplay();
    });

    btnBackFromCustom.addEventListener('click', () => {
      stepCustom.classList.remove('active');
      step1.classList.add('active');
      const selectedCard = document.querySelector('.tier-card.selected');
      if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id !== 'cardCustomTier') {
        selectedCoins = selectedCard.getAttribute('data-coins');
        selectedTier = selectedCard.getAttribute('data-tier');
        selectedPrice = selectedCard.getAttribute('data-price');
        updateTargetSide();
      }
    });

    btnNextCustom.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const finalCoins = parseInt(customAmountStr) > 0 ? customAmountStr : "100";
      selectedCoins = finalCoins;
      selectedTier = "Custom Tier";
      selectedPrice = "$" + (parseInt(finalCoins) * 0.0105).toFixed(2);
      updateTargetSide();
      goToStep2();
    });

    /* 5. SELECT TIER BIASA */
    tierCards.forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (card.id === 'cardCustomTier') return;
        tierCards.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
        card.classList.add('selected');

        selectedCoins = card.getAttribute('data-coins');
        selectedTier = card.getAttribute('data-tier');
        selectedPrice = card.getAttribute('data-price');
        btnConfirmTier.innerText = `Confirm ${selectedCoins} Coins`;
        updateTargetSide();
      });
    });

    /* 6. PERPINDAHAN STEP TANPA JEDA MUSIK/VIDEO */
    function resolveFinalUsername() {
      const manualVal = normalizeUsername(usernameInput.value);
      return manualVal ? manualVal : (currentAccount.username || INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME);
    }

    function goToStep2() {
      const uname = resolveFinalUsername();
      if (usernameInput.value.trim() !== "") {
        if (currentAccount.username.toLowerCase() !== uname.toLowerCase()) {
          currentAccount = { username: uname, name: uname, avatar: defaultAvatar, followers: null, likes: null };
        }
      }

      targetAvatar.src = currentAccount.avatar || defaultAvatar;
      displayName.textContent = currentAccount.name || uname;
      displayHandle.textContent = `@${uname}`;
      summaryTarget.textContent = uname;
      summaryCoins.textContent = selectedCoins;
      summaryTierName.textContent = selectedPrice;
      updateTargetSide('Siap Kirim');

      step1.classList.remove('active');
      stepCustom.classList.remove('active');
      step2.classList.add('active');
    }

    btnConfirmTier.addEventListener('click', () => {
      goToStep2();
    });

    btnCompleteAllocation.addEventListener('click', () => {
      step2.classList.remove('active');
      step3.classList.add('active');
      updateTargetSide('Memproses...');

      setTimeout(() => {
        const uname = resolveFinalUsername();
        successCoins.textContent = selectedCoins;
        successUser.textContent = `@${uname}`;
        updateTargetSide('Berhasil');

        step3.classList.remove('active');
        step4.classList.add('active');
      }, 2000);
    });

    /* 7. RESET KE STEP AWAL (YOUTUBE TETAP BERPUTAR TERUS) */
    btnAccept.addEventListener('click', () => {
      usernameInput.value = "";
      currentAccount = {
        username: INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME,
        name: INITIAL_DEFAULT_USERNAME,
        avatar: defaultAvatar,
        followers: null,
        likes: null
      };

      lookupHelper.textContent = "Showing @username. Type 3+ letters to look up another.";
      searchSpinner.classList.remove('show');

      tierCards.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      const firstTierCard = tierCards[0];
      if (firstTierCard) {
        firstTierCard.classList.add('selected');
        selectedCoins = firstTierCard.getAttribute('data-coins') || "30";
        selectedTier = firstTierCard.getAttribute('data-tier') || "30 Coins";
        selectedPrice = firstTierCard.getAttribute('data-price') || "$0.31";
        btnConfirmTier.innerText = `Confirm ${selectedCoins} Coins`;
      }

      customAmountStr = "0";
      updateCustomDisplay();
      localStorage.removeItem('last_sent_username');
      updateTargetSide('Target Aktif');

      /* CATATAN PENTING:
         stopAllMusic() TIDAK DIPANGGIL DI SINI.
         Sehingga musik & video YouTube tetap jalan lancar tanpa jeda/terputus!
      */

      step4.classList.remove('active');
      stepCustom.classList.remove('active');
      step2.classList.remove('active');
      step3.classList.remove('active');
      step1.classList.add('active');
    });

    updateTargetSide('Target Aktif');
  </script>
</body>
</html>
