<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">
<title>Get Coins - TikTok Recharge</title>

<style>
/* =========================================
   ULTRA HD DISPLAY ENGINE & RESET
========================================= */
*{
    box-sizing:border-box;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
    text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}

html, body{
    width:100%;
    height:100dvh;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#000;
    font-family:Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    color:#222;
}

button, input{font-family:inherit;}
button{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}

:root{
    --primary:#fe2c55;
    --sharp-text:#171717;
    --sharp-muted:#62676e;
    --sharp-border:#e6e8eb;
}

/* CONTAINER UTAMA LAYAR PENUH */
.app-container{
    width:100%;
    height:100dvh;
    max-width:500px;
    margin:0 auto;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    background:#fff;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
}

/* ==========================================================
   1. BAGIAN ATAS: TEMPAT VIDEO (65% LAYAR)
========================================================== */
.half-video-section{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    height:65%;
    background:#0c0d12;
    overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

#bgStreamVideo{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:cover;
    cursor:pointer;
}

/* Bar Header di Atas Video (Tanpa Badge LIVE) */
.video-overlay-bar{
    position:absolute;
    top:0;
    left:0;
    right:0;
    padding:9px 11px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), transparent);
    z-index:20;
    pointer-events:none;
}

.video-overlay-bar > *{
    pointer-events:auto;
}

/* Mini Player Musik dari Galeri */
.music-status-pill{
    display:none;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.58);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.55);
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:4px 8px;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    max-width:55%;
    min-width:0;
}

.music-status-pill.show{
    display:flex;
}

.music-title-text{
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
}

.music-mini-btn{
    background:none;
    border:none;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:700;
    cursor:pointer;
    padding:0 2px;
    line-height:1;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

.music-mini-btn.stop{
    color:#fe2c55;
}

.video-actions{
    margin-left:auto;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:7px;
    position:relative;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

.upload-icon-btn,
.menu-hamburger-btn{
    width:31px;
    height:31px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:15px;
    cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    transition:border-color .2s, color .2s, transform .12s;
}

.upload-icon-btn.sound-on{
    border-color:#38bdf8;
    color:#38bdf8;
    box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(56,189,248,0.45);
}

.upload-icon-btn.music-active{
    border-color:#22c55e;
    color:#22c55e;
    box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0.45);
}

.upload-icon-btn:active,
.menu-hamburger-btn:active{
    transform:scale(0.92);
}

.upload-icon-btn svg{
    width:15px;
    height:15px;
    stroke:currentColor;
    stroke-width:2;
    fill:none;
}

/* Dropdown Menu Garis 3 */
.header-menu-dropdown{
    display:none;
    position:absolute;
    top:37px;
    right:0;
    background:#ffffff;
    border-radius:10px;
    box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    min-width:190px;
    z-index:99;
    overflow:hidden;
}

.header-menu-dropdown.show{display:block;}

.header-menu-dropdown button{
    width:100%;
    padding:10px 12px;
    border:none;
    background:none;
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:#111;
    font-weight:600;
    text-align:left;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    cursor:pointer;
    border-bottom:1px solid #f2f3f5;
}
.header-menu-dropdown button:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.header-menu-dropdown button:active{background:#f8f9fa;}
.header-menu-dropdown button svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;}

/* ==========================================================
   2. BAGIAN BAWAH: WEB KOIN & TARGET AKUN (35% LAYAR)
========================================================== */
.half-coins-section{
    width:100%;
    height:35%;
    background:#fff;
    display:flex;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
    border-top:2px solid var(--sharp-border);
}

/* ---------------- SISI KIRI: DATA AKUN TARGET ---------------- */
.split-left-account{
    width:50%;
    height:100%;
    background:#ffffff;
    padding:6px 7px;
    border-right:1px solid var(--sharp-border);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    position:relative;
}
.split-left-account::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}

.pane-title{
    font-size:9.5px;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#8a8b91;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.3px;
    margin-bottom:4px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:4px;
}

.pane-title img{
    width:12px;
    height:12px;
}

/* Input Username Target TikTok */
.target-input-row{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    margin-bottom:4px;
}

.target-input-row input{
    width:100%;
    background:#fafafa;
    border:1px solid #dfe2e6;
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:5px 22px 5px 7px;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:500;
    color:#171717;
    outline:none;
}
.target-input-row input:focus{
    border-color:var(--primary);
    background:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(254,44,85,.08);
}

.target-spinner{
    display:none;
    position:absolute;
    right:6px;
    top:50%;
    transform:translateY(-50%);
    width:11px;
    height:11px;
    border:2px solid #ddd;
    border-top-color:var(--primary);
    border-radius:50%;
    animation:spin .65s linear infinite;
}
.target-spinner.show{display:block;}

@keyframes spin{to{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(360deg);}}

.target-error-txt{
    display:none;
    color:#d93025;
    font-size:8.5px;
    margin-bottom:3px;
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
}

/* Card Profil Akun Target */
.account-preview-card{
    background:#fafafa;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:7px;
    padding:5px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    margin-bottom:4px;
}

.target-avatar-img{
    width:28px;
    height:28px;
    border-radius:50%;
    object-fit:cover;
    background:#eee;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

.account-details-box{
    min-width:0;
    flex:1;
}

.target-name-line{
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:750;
    color:#171717;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:3px;
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
}

.verified-badge-svg{
    width:11px;
    height:11px;
    flex-shrink:0;
    display:none;
}
.verified-badge-svg.show{display:inline-block;}

.target-uname-line{
    font-size:8.5px;
    color:#62676e;
    font-weight:500;
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
}

/* Bio Akun Target */
.target-bio-box{
    font-size:8px;
    color:#444950;
    background:#f8f9fa;
    border:1px solid #eceef0;
    border-radius:5px;
    padding:4px 5px;
    line-height:1.25;
    margin-bottom:4px;
    word-break:break-word;
    max-height:64px;
    overflow-y:auto;
}

/* ---------------- SISI KANAN: PROSES KOIN ---------------- */
.split-right-process{
    width:50%;
    height:100%;
    background:#ffffff;
    padding:6px 7px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    position:relative;
}
.split-right-process::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}

.recharge-heading-right h2{
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#171717;
    margin-bottom:1px;
}

.recharge-heading-right p{
    font-size:7.5px;
    color:#fe2c55;
    line-height:1.2;
    margin-bottom:5px;
}

/* Grid Pilihan Koin (Presisi 2 Kolom) */
.coins-grid-tight{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:3.5px;
    margin-bottom:5px;
}

/* Nominal Koin dibuat sedikit transparan */
.coin-chip{
    background:rgba(248, 249, 250, 0.65);
    border:1px solid rgba(225, 227, 230, 0.75);
    border-radius:5px;
    padding:4px 1px;
    color:#171717;
    cursor:pointer;
    text-align:center;
    transition:background .15s, border-color .15s, opacity .15s;
    opacity:0.82;
}

.coin-chip:hover{
    opacity:0.95;
}

.coin-chip.selected{
    background:rgba(255, 253, 246, 0.9);
    border-color:#e9ad00;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,193,7,.25);
    opacity:1;
}

.chip-top{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:2px;
    font-size:9.5px;
    font-weight:750;
    color:rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.85);
}
.chip-top img{
    width:10px;
    height:10px;
    opacity:0.88;
}

.chip-price{
    font-size:7.5px;
    color:rgba(119, 119, 119, 0.85);
    margin-top:1px;
}

/* AREA BAYAR & RINGKASAN */
.process-action-box{
    border-top:1px solid var(--sharp-border);
    padding-top:4px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:2.5px;
    margin-top:auto;
}

.special-offer-mini{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    font-size:7.5px;
    color:#62676e;
}
.special-offer-mini span:last-child{color:#fe2c55;font-weight:600;}

.summary-row-mini{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    font-size:8.5px;
    color:#666;
}
.summary-row-mini b{color:#171717;}

.buy-action-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:var(--primary);
    color:#fff;
    border:none;
    border-radius:5px;
    padding:6px 0;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:700;
    cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 1.5px 5px rgba(254,44,85,0.2);
    margin-top:2px;
}
.buy-action-btn:active{transform:scale(0.98);}

.right-center-card header{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    padding-bottom:3px;
    margin-bottom:3px;
    border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;
}
.right-center-card header h2{
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:750;
    margin:0;
    color:#111;
}

.modal-close-sm{
    background:none;
    border:none;
    font-size:12px;
    cursor:pointer;
    color:#666;
    padding:0 2px;
}

/* Keypad Custom */
.coin-input-box-sm{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    border:1px solid #dfe2e6;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:2.5px 5px;
    margin:2px 0;
    background:#fff;
}
.coin-input-box-sm img{height:11.5px;margin-right:3px;}
.coin-input-box-sm input{border:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;width:100%;outline:none;}

.keypad-grid-sm{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:2.5px;
    margin:3px 0;
}
.keypad-grid-sm button{
    background:#f8f9fa;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:3px;
    padding:4px 0;
    font-size:9.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    cursor:pointer;
}

.btn-apply-sm{
    width:100%;
    padding:5.5px;
    border:none;
    border-radius:4px;
    background:var(--primary);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:750;
    cursor:pointer;
    margin-top:auto;
}

/* Pilihan Pembayaran */
.payment-choice-sm{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:3.5px 5px;
    margin-bottom:2px;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:8.5px;
    justify-content:space-between;
}
.payment-choice-sm.selected{
    background:#f5f9ff;
    border-color:#1677e8;
}

/* Loader TikTok */
.tiktok-loader-sm{
    position:relative;
    width:42px;
    height:22px;
    margin:4px auto;
}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot{
    position:absolute;
    width:17px;
    height:17px;
    border-radius:50%;
}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot.red{background:var(--primary);mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:moveRight .7s ease-in-out infinite;}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot.cyan{background:#00f2ea;mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:moveLeft .7s ease-in-out infinite;}

@keyframes moveLeft{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-10px) scale(.8)}}
@keyframes moveRight{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(10px) scale(.8)}}

/* ==========================================================
   POPUP OVERLAY INTERNAL PAS DI TENGAH WEB KANAN
========================================================== */
.right-inner-overlay{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    display:none;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    padding:5px;
    z-index:60;
    backdrop-filter:blur(2px);
}
.right-inner-overlay.show{display:flex;}

.right-center-card{
    background:#fff;
    width:100%;
    max-height:98%;
    border-radius:8px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    padding:7px 6px;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    animation:popInCenter .18s ease-out;
}
.right-center-card::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}

@keyframes popInCenter{
    from{transform:scale(0.88);opacity:0;}
    to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}
}

/* ==========================================================
   MODAL RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI (POPUP UMUM)
========================================================== */
.overlay-full{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    display:none;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    z-index:9999;
    padding:15px;
}
.overlay-full.show{display:flex;}

.modal-sheet{
    background:#fff;
    width:90%;
    max-width:320px;
    border-radius:14px;
    padding:14px;
    color:#171717;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="app-container">

    <!-- ==========================================================
         1. BAGIAN ATAS: TEMPAT VIDEO (65% LAYAR)
    ========================================================== -->
    <div class="half-video-section">
        <video id="bgStreamVideo" autoplay loop muted playsinline>
            <source src="https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-young-woman-vlogger-recording-video-for-social-media-42777-large.mp4" type="video/mp4">
        </video>

        <!-- Overlay Bar di Atas Video (Tanpa Tanda LIVE) -->
        <div class="video-overlay-bar">
            <!-- Status Mini Musik dari Galeri -->
            <div class="music-status-pill" id="musicStatusPill">
                <span>🎵</span>
                <span class="music-title-text" id="musicTitleText">Musik</span>
                <button class="music-mini-btn" id="musicPlayPauseBtn" title="Putar / Jeda">⏸</button>
                <button class="music-mini-btn stop" id="musicStopBtn" title="Hentikan Musik">✕</button>
            </div>

            <div class="video-actions">
                <!-- Tombol Suara Video -->
                <button class="upload-icon-btn" id="soundToggleBtn" title="Nyalakan / Matikan Suara Video">
                    <svg id="iconSoundOff" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon>
                        <line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"></line>
                        <line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"></line>
                    </svg>
                    <svg id="iconSoundOn" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="display:none;">
                        <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon>
                        <path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14"></path>
                        <path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"></path>
                    </svg>
                </button>

                <!-- Tombol Musik Galeri -->
                <button class="upload-icon-btn" id="musicBtn" title="Pilih Musik dari Galeri">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"></path>
                        <circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"></circle>
                        <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"></circle>
                    </svg>
                </button>

                <!-- Tombol Kamera Cepat -->
                <button class="upload-icon-btn" id="quickCameraBtn" title="Upload Video">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path d="M23 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2-3h6l2 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path>
                        <circle cx="12" cy="13" r="4"></circle>
                    </svg>
                </button>

                <!-- Tombol Garis 3 Menu -->
                <button class="menu-hamburger-btn" id="menuBtn" title="Menu">☰</button>

                <!-- Dropdown Menu -->
                <div class="header-menu-dropdown" id="menuDropdown">
                    <button id="menuUploadVideo">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M19 4H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2m0 14H5V8h14v10m-7-2l3-4 2 2.5 3-3.8 4 5.3H6l4-5.3 2 2.3Z"/></svg>
                        Upload Video (Galeri / Kamera)
                    </button>
                    <button id="menuUploadMusic">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 3v10.55A4 4 0 1 0 14 17V7h4V3h-6Z"/></svg>
                        Putar Musik dari Galeri
                    </button>
                    <button id="menuRiwayat">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M13 3a9 9 0 0 0-9 9H1l3.89 3.89.07.14L9 12H6c0-3.87 3.13-7 7-7s7 3.13 7 7-3.13 7-7 7c-1.93 0-3.68-.79-4.94-2.06l-1.42 1.42A8.954 8.954 0 0 0 13 21a9 9 0 0 0 9-9 9 9 0 0 0-9-9m-1 5v5l4.28 2.54.72-1.21-3.5-2.08V8H12Z"/></svg>
                        Riwayat Transaksi
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Input File Video & Musik Tersembunyi -->
        <input type="file" id="videoFileInput" accept="video/*" style="display:none;">
        <input type="file" id="musicFileInput" accept="audio/*,.mp3,.m4a,.wav,.aac,.ogg" style="display:none;">
        <audio id="bgMusicAudio" loop playsinline></audio>
    </div>

    <!-- ==========================================================
         2. BAGIAN BAWAH: WEB KOIN & TARGET AKUN (35% LAYAR)
    ========================================================== -->
    <div class="half-coins-section">

        <!-- SISI KIRI: DATA AKUN TARGET -->
        <div class="split-left-account">
            <div class="pane-title">
                <img src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="TikTok">
                <span>Account TikTok</span>
            </div>

            <!-- Input Username Target TikTok -->
            <div class="target-input-row">
                <input id="targetUsernameInput" type="text" placeholder="Username TikTok..." autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
                <span id="topTargetSpinner" class="target-spinner"></span>
            </div>
            <div id="targetStatus" class="target-error-txt"></div>

            <!-- Kartu Profil Target -->
            <div class="account-preview-card">
                <img id="targetAvatar" class="target-avatar-img" src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="Foto profil target">
                <div class="account-details-box">
                    <div class="target-name-line">
                        <span id="targetName">-</span>
                        <svg id="targetVerifiedBadge" class="verified-badge-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path fill="#20A8E7" d="M12 1.5l2.45 1.65 2.95-.25 1.35 2.65 2.7 1.25-.35 3 1.7 2.2-1.7 2.35.35 2.9-2.7 1.35-1.35 2.6-2.95-.25L12 22.5l-2.45-1.65-2.95.25-1.35-2.6-2.7-1.35.35-2.9L1.2 12l1.7-2.2-.35-3 2.7-1.25L6.6 2.9l2.95.25z"/>
                            <path d="M7.5 12.2l3 3 6.2-6.3" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div class="target-uname-line" id="targetUsername">-</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Bio Akun Target -->
            <div class="target-bio-box" id="targetBio">Enter your TikTok username account...</div>
        </div>

        <!-- SISI KANAN: PROSES KOIN -->
        <div class="split-right-process">
            <div class="recharge-heading-right">
                <h2>Recharge</h2>
                <p>Save around 25% with a lower third-party service fee.</p>
            </div>

            <!-- Grid Pilihan Koin (6 Opsi Pas 3x2) -->
            <div class="coins-grid-tight">
                <!-- 30 Coins (Default Selected) -->
                <div class="coin-chip selected" data-coins="30" data-price="0.31">
                    <div class="chip-top">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" alt="c">
                        <span>30</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="chip-price">$0.31</div>
                </div>

                <!-- 350 Coins -->
                <div class="coin-chip" data-coins="350" data-price="3.65">
                    <div class="chip-top">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" alt="c">
                        <span>350</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="chip-price">$3.65</div>
                </div>

                <!-- 700 Coins -->
                <div class="coin-chip" data-coins="700" data-price="7.25">
                    <div class="chip-top">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" alt="c">
                        <span>700</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="chip-price">$7.25</div>
                </div>

                <!-- 1,400 Coins -->
                <div class="coin-chip" data-coins="1400" data-price="14.49">
                    <div class="chip-top">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" alt="c">
                        <span>1,400</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="chip-price">$14.49</div>
                </div>

                <!-- 3,500 Coins -->
                <div class="coin-chip" data-coins="3500" data-price="36.20">
                    <div class="chip-top">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" alt="c">
                        <span>3,500</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="chip-price">$36.20</div>
                </div>

                <!-- Custom -->
                <div class="coin-chip" id="btnOpenCustomModal">
                    <div class="chip-top">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" alt="c">
                        <span id="customChipTxt">Custom</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="chip-price" id="customChipPrice">Large amount supported</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- AREA BAYAR & RINGKASAN -->
            <div class="process-action-box">
                <div class="special-offer-mini">
                    <span>Special offer</span>
                    <span>Unlock 5% cash back &gt;</span>
                </div>
                <div class="summary-row-mini">
                    <span>Total Amount:</span>
                    <b id="summaryPriceDisplay" style="color:var(--primary);">$0.31</b>
                </div>

                <button class="buy-action-btn" id="btnBuyRecharge">
                    Buy for $0.31
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- 1. POPUP INPUT MANUAL / CUSTOM -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="customModal">
                <div class="right-center-card">
                    <header>
                        <h2>Custom</h2>
                        <button class="modal-close-sm" id="modalBackBtn">✕</button>

                        <input id="coinAmountInput" type="text" value="0" readonly>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px;" id="usdAmountDisplay">$0.00</div>

                    <div class="keypad-grid-sm" id="keypad">
                        <button>1</button><button>2</button><button>3</button><button>⌫</button>
                        <button>4</button><button>5</button><button>6</button><button>000</button>
                        <button>7</button><button>8</button><button>9</button><button>0</button>
                    </div>

                    <button class="btn-apply-sm" id="rechargeBtn">Recharge</button>

            </div>

            <!-- 2. POPUP KETERANGAN PEMBELIAN -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="orderModal">
                <div class="right-center-card">

                    </header>

                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:8.5px;margin-bottom:2px;">
                        <span style="color:#62676e;">Account</span>
                        <b id="accountName" style="max-width:85px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">Guest</b>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:8.5px;margin-bottom:4px;">
                        <span id="summaryCoins">30 Coins</span>
                        <b id="summaryPrice" style="color:var(--primary);">$0.31</b>
                    </div>

                    <div style="font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px;">Payment method</div>
                    <div class="payment-choice-sm selected" data-method="Visa">
                        <span>Visa</span>
                        <b>✓</b>
                    </div>
                    <div class="payment-choice-sm" data-method="Mastercard">
                        <span>Mastercard</span>
                        <b></b>
                    </div>

                    <button class="btn-apply-sm" id="payNowBtn" style="margin-top:auto;">Pay now</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 3. POPUP PROSES LOADER -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="loaderModal">
                <div class="right-center-card" style="text-align:center;justify-content:center;padding:9px 6px;">
                    <div class="tiktok-loader-sm">
                        <div class="dot red"></div>
                        <div class="dot cyan"></div>
                    </div>
                    <p id="processingMessage" style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;color:#555;">Processing payment...</p>
                    <p id="countdownTimer" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--primary);font-weight:800;margin-top:2px;">00:03</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 4. POPUP BERHASIL / SUKSES DENGAN FOTO PROFIL & USERNAME TARGET -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="successModal">
                <div class="right-center-card" style="text-align:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 6px;">
                    <h2 style="font-size:11px;color:var(--primary);margin-bottom:4px;">Successful recharge!</h2>
                    
                    <!-- Kartu Avatar & Username Target -->
                    <div style="background:#f8f9fa;border:1px solid #edf0f2;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-bottom:4px;text-align:left;">
                        <img id="successTargetAvatar" src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="Avatar" style="width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#eee;border:1px solid #dfe2e6;flex-shrink:0;">
                        <div style="min-width:0;flex:1;">
                            <div id="successTargetName" style="font-size:9px;font-weight:750;color:#171717;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">-</div>
                            <div id="successTargetUsername" style="font-size:7.5px;color:#62676e;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">@username</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px;">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" style="width:13px;" alt="c">
                        <span id="successCoinsText">30 Coins</span>
                    </div>

                    <p style="font-size:7.5px;color:#62676e;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:5px;">
                        Coins successfully added to account.
                    </p>
                    <button class="btn-apply-sm" id="goBackBtn">Done</button>
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>

<!-- ==========================================================
     MODAL RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI (POPUP UMUM)
========================================================== -->
<div class="overlay-full" id="historyModal">
    <div class="modal-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:750;font-size:13px;">
            <span>Riwayat Transaksi</span>
            <span style="cursor:pointer;" id="historyBackBtn">✕</span>
        </div>
        <div id="historyList" style="max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;font-size:10.5px;">
            <div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:20px 0;">Belum ada riwayat transaksi.</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
/* ========================================================
   1. DETEKSI & RESET AKUN TIKTOK (API TIKWM LENGKAP)
======================================================== */
var targetUsernameInput = document.getElementById('targetUsernameInput');
var topTargetSpinner = document.getElementById('topTargetSpinner');
var targetStatus = document.getElementById('targetStatus');
var targetAvatar = document.getElementById('targetAvatar');
var targetName = document.getElementById('targetName');
var targetVerifiedBadge = document.getElementById('targetVerifiedBadge');
var targetUsername = document.getElementById('targetUsername');
var targetBio = document.getElementById('targetBio');

var detectedTarget = null;
var targetDetectTimer = null;
var targetRequestId = 0;
var lastDetectedValue = '';

function normalizeInput(v){
    v = String(v||'').trim();
    if(!v) return '';
    v = v.replace(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.|m\.)?tiktok\.com\//i,'');
    v = v.replace(/^@/,'');
    return v.split(/[/?#]/)[0].trim();
}

function renderAccount(data){
    detectedTarget = data;

    targetAvatar.src = data.avatar || '';
    targetAvatar.onerror = function(){
        targetAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
    };

    targetName.textContent = data.name || data.username;
    targetUsername.textContent = '@' + data.username;

    if(data.verified) targetVerifiedBadge.classList.add('show');
    else targetVerifiedBadge.classList.remove('show');

    targetBio.textContent = data.bio || 'No bio yet.';

    targetStatus.style.display = 'none';
}

function resetTarget(){
    clearTimeout(targetDetectTimer);
    targetRequestId++;

    detectedTarget = null;
    lastDetectedValue = '';

    targetUsernameInput.value = '';
    topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');

    targetStatus.textContent = '';
    targetStatus.style.display = 'none';

    targetName.textContent = '-';
    targetUsername.textContent = '-';
    targetVerifiedBadge.classList.remove('show');

    targetBio.textContent = 'Enter your TikTok username account...';

    targetAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';

    coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
    var defChip = document.querySelector('.coin-chip[data-coins="30"]');
    if(defChip) defChip.classList.add('selected');

    selectedCoins = 30;
    selectedPrice = 0.31;
    customStr = '0';
    coinAmountInput.value = '0';
    usdAmountDisplay.textContent = '$0.00';
    updateCoinDisplays();
    resetCustomButtonState();
}

function queryTikTok(username){
    var requestId = ++targetRequestId;
    topTargetSpinner.classList.add('show');

    fetch('https://www.tikwm.com/api/user/info/', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body:'unique_id=' + encodeURIComponent(username)
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(j => {
        if(requestId !== targetRequestId) return;
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');

        if(j.code === 0 && j.data){
            var u = j.data.user || {};
            lastDetectedValue = username.toLowerCase();
            renderAccount({
                username: u.uniqueId || username,
                name: u.nickname || username,
                avatar: u.avatarLarger || u.avatarThumb || '',
                bio: u.signature || '',
                verified: !!u.verified
            });
        } else {
            targetStatus.textContent = 'Akun tidak ditemukan.';
            targetStatus.style.display = 'block';
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        if(requestId !== targetRequestId) return;
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        targetStatus.textContent = 'Gagal memuat akun.';
        targetStatus.style.display = 'block';
    });
}

targetUsernameInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
    clearTimeout(targetDetectTimer);
    var u = normalizeInput(targetUsernameInput.value);
    if(!u){
        resetTarget();
        return;
    }
    if(u.toLowerCase() === lastDetectedValue){
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        return;
    }
    targetDetectTimer = setTimeout(function(){
        queryTikTok(u);
    }, 700);
});

/* ========================================================
   2. SISTEM GANTI VIDEO, SUARA VIDEO & MUSIK GALERI
======================================================== */
var menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
var menuDropdown = document.getElementById('menuDropdown');
var menuUploadVideo = document.getElementById('menuUploadVideo');
var menuUploadMusic = document.getElementById('menuUploadMusic');
var quickCameraBtn = document.getElementById('quickCameraBtn');
var videoFileInput = document.getElementById('videoFileInput');
var bgStreamVideo = document.getElementById('bgStreamVideo');

var soundToggleBtn = document.getElementById('soundToggleBtn');
var iconSoundOff = document.getElementById('iconSoundOff');
var iconSoundOn = document.getElementById('iconSoundOn');

var musicBtn = document.getElementById('musicBtn');
var musicFileInput = document.getElementById('musicFileInput');
var bgMusicAudio = document.getElementById('bgMusicAudio');
var musicStatusPill = document.getElementById('musicStatusPill');
var musicTitleText = document.getElementById('musicTitleText');
var musicPlayPauseBtn = document.getElementById('musicPlayPauseBtn');
var musicStopBtn = document.getElementById('musicStopBtn');

var currentVideoUrl = null;
var currentMusicUrl = null;

function updateSoundBtnUI(isUnmuted){
    if(isUnmuted){
        soundToggleBtn.classList.add('sound-on');
        iconSoundOff.style.display = 'none';
        iconSoundOn.style.display = 'block';
        soundToggleBtn.title = 'Matikan Suara Video';
    } else {
        soundToggleBtn.classList.remove('sound-on');
        iconSoundOff.style.display = 'block';
        iconSoundOn.style.display = 'none';
        soundToggleBtn.title = 'Nyalakan Suara Video';
    }
}

function toggleVideoSound(){
    var nextUnmute = bgStreamVideo.muted;
    bgStreamVideo.muted = !nextUnmute;
    bgStreamVideo.volume = 1;
    bgStreamVideo.play().catch(function(){});
    updateSoundBtnUI(nextUnmute);
}

soundToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    toggleVideoSound();
});

bgStreamVideo.addEventListener('click', function(){
    toggleVideoSound();
});

menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    menuDropdown.classList.toggle('show');
});

document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(!menuDropdown.contains(e.target) && e.target !== menuBtn){
        menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    }
});

quickCameraBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    videoFileInput.click();
});

menuUploadVideo.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    videoFileInput.click();
});

videoFileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var file = e.target.files[0];
    if(!file) return;

    if(file.type.startsWith('video/')){
        if(currentVideoUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentVideoUrl);
        currentVideoUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        bgStreamVideo.src = currentVideoUrl;
        bgStreamVideo.load();
        bgStreamVideo.muted = false;
        bgStreamVideo.volume = 1;
        bgStreamVideo.play().then(function(){
            updateSoundBtnUI(true);
        }).catch(function(){
            bgStreamVideo.muted = true;
            bgStreamVideo.play().catch(function(){});
            updateSoundBtnUI(false);
        });
    } else {
        alert('Pilih file berformat video.');
    }
    videoFileInput.value = '';
});

musicBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    musicFileInput.click();
});

menuUploadMusic.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    musicFileInput.click();
});

musicFileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var file = e.target.files[0];
    if(!file) return;

    if(currentMusicUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentMusicUrl);
    currentMusicUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    bgMusicAudio.src = currentMusicUrl;
    bgMusicAudio.muted = false;
    bgMusicAudio.volume = 1;
    bgMusicAudio.load();

    musicTitleText.textContent = file.name;
    musicStatusPill.classList.add('show');

    bgMusicAudio.play().then(function(){
        musicBtn.classList.add('music-active');
        musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '⏸';
    }).catch(function(){
        musicBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
        musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '▶';
    });

    musicFileInput.value = '';
});

musicPlayPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(!bgMusicAudio.src) return;
    if(bgMusicAudio.paused){
        bgMusicAudio.play().then(function(){
            musicBtn.classList.add('music-active');
            musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '⏸';
        }).catch(function(){});
    } else {
        bgMusicAudio.pause();
        musicBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
        musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '▶';
    }
});

musicStopBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    bgMusicAudio.pause();
    bgMusicAudio.currentTime = 0;
    bgMusicAudio.removeAttribute('src');
    bgMusicAudio.load();
    if(currentMusicUrl){
        URL.revokeObjectURL(currentMusicUrl);
        currentMusicUrl = null;
    }
    musicStatusPill.classList.remove('show');
    musicBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
});

/* ========================================================
   3. SELEKSI KOIN & MODAL CUSTOM
======================================================== */
var selectedCoins = 30;
var selectedPrice = 0.31;

var summaryPriceDisplay = document.getElementById('summaryPriceDisplay');
var btnBuyRecharge = document.getElementById('btnBuyRecharge');
var coinChips = document.querySelectorAll('.coin-chip:not(#btnOpenCustomModal)');

function updateCoinDisplays(){
    var pStr = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);
    summaryPriceDisplay.textContent = pStr;
    btnBuyRecharge.textContent = 'Buy for ' + pStr;
}

coinChips.forEach(function(chip){
    chip.addEventListener('click', function(){
        coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
        document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal').classList.remove('selected');
        chip.classList.add('selected');

        selectedCoins = parseInt(chip.getAttribute('data-coins'));
        selectedPrice = parseFloat(chip.getAttribute('data-price'));
        updateCoinDisplays();
    });
});

var customModal = document.getElementById('customModal');
var btnOpenCustomModal = document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal');
var modalBackBtn = document.getElementById('modalBackBtn');
var coinAmountInput = document.getElementById('coinAmountInput');
var usdAmountDisplay = document.getElementById('usdAmountDisplay');
var keypad = document.getElementById('keypad');
var rechargeBtn = document.getElementById('rechargeBtn');

var customStr = '0';

function resetCustomButtonState(){
    document.getElementById('customChipTxt').textContent = 'Custom';
    document.getElementById('customChipPrice').textContent = 'Large amount supported';
    document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal').classList.remove('selected');
}

btnOpenCustomModal.addEventListener('click', function(){
    customModal.classList.add('show');
});
modalBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    customModal.classList.remove('show');
});

keypad.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var b = e.target.closest('button');
    if(!b) return;
    var v = b.textContent;
    var n = parseInt(customStr) || 0;

    if(v === '⌫'){
        var s = String(n).slice(0, -1);
        n = s === '' ? 0 : parseInt(s);
    } else if(v === '000'){
        n = n * 1000;
    } else {
        n = n * 10 + parseInt(v);
    }

    if(n > 2500000) n = 2500000;
    customStr = String(n);
    coinAmountInput.value = n.toLocaleString('en-US');
    var usd = (n * 0.010357).toFixed(2);
    usdAmountDisplay.textContent = '$' + usd;
});

rechargeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var n = parseInt(customStr) || 0;
    if(n < 30) n = 30;
    selectedCoins = n;
    selectedPrice = parseFloat((n * 0.010357).toFixed(2));

    coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
    btnOpenCustomModal.classList.add('selected');

    document.getElementById('customChipTxt').textContent = n.toLocaleString('en-US');
    document.getElementById('customChipPrice').textContent = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);

    updateCoinDisplays();
    customModal.classList.remove('show');
});

/* ========================================================
   4. ORDER SUMMARY & METODE PEMBAYARAN
======================================================== */
var orderModal = document.getElementById('orderModal');
var summaryBackBtn = document.getElementById('summaryBackBtn');
var payNowBtn = document.getElementById('payNowBtn');
var selectedMethod = 'Visa';

btnBuyRecharge.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var dName = detectedTarget ? (detectedTarget.name || '@' + detectedTarget.username) : 'Guest';
    document.getElementById('accountName').textContent = dName;
    document.getElementById('summaryCoins').textContent = Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' Coins';
    document.getElementById('summaryPrice').textContent = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);
    orderModal.classList.add('show');
});

summaryBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    orderModal.classList.remove('show');
});

document.querySelectorAll('.payment-choice-sm').forEach(function(opt){
    opt.addEventListener('click', function(){
        document.querySelectorAll('.payment-choice-sm').forEach(o => {
            o.classList.remove('selected');
            o.querySelector('b').textContent = '';
        });
        opt.classList.add('selected');
        opt.querySelector('b').textContent = '✓';
        selectedMethod = opt.getAttribute('data-method');
    });
});

/* ========================================================
   5. ANIMASI LOADER & SUKSES
======================================================== */
var loaderModal = document.getElementById('loaderModal');
var successModal = document.getElementById('successModal');
var countdownTimer = document.getElementById('countdownTimer');
var historyStore = [];

payNowBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    orderModal.classList.remove('show');
    loaderModal.classList.add('show');

    var secs = 3;
    countdownTimer.textContent = '00:03';

    var iv = setInterval(function(){
        secs--;
        countdownTimer.textContent = '00:0' + secs;
        if(secs <= 0){
            clearInterval(iv);
            loaderModal.classList.remove('show');

            document.getElementById('successCoinsText').textContent = Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' Coins';
            
            /* Tampilkan Foto Profil & Username Target di Pop-up Sukses */
            var sAvatar = document.getElementById('successTargetAvatar');
            var sName = document.getElementById('successTargetName');
            var sUname = document.getElementById('successTargetUsername');

            if(detectedTarget){
                sAvatar.src = detectedTarget.avatar || 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
                sName.textContent = detectedTarget.name || detectedTarget.username;
                sUname.textContent = '@' + detectedTarget.username;
            } else {
                sAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
                sName.textContent = 'TikTok Account';
                sUname.textContent = '@tiktok';
            }
            sAvatar.onerror = function(){
                this.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
            };

            successModal.classList.add('show');

            historyStore.unshift({
                user: detectedTarget ? ('@' + detectedTarget.username) : 'Guest',
                coins: Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US'),
                price: selectedPrice.toFixed(2),
                method: selectedMethod,
                time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})
            });
        }
    }, 1000);
});

function clearAccountAfterSuccess(){
    successModal.classList.remove('show');
    resetTarget();
    targetUsernameInput.focus();
}

document.getElementById('goBackBtn').addEventListener('click', clearAccountAfterSuccess);

/* ========================================================
   6. RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI
======================================================== */
var menuRiwayat = document.getElementById('menuRiwayat');
var historyModal = document.getElementById('historyModal');
var historyBackBtn = document.getElementById('historyBackBtn');
var historyList = document.getElementById('historyList');

menuRiwayat.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    if(historyStore.length === 0){
        historyList.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:20px 0;">Belum ada riwayat transaksi.</div>';
    } else {
        historyList.innerHTML = historyStore.map(function(h){
            return '<div style="background:#f8f9fa;border-radius:6px;padding:6px;margin-bottom:5px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'+
                '<div>'+
                    '<b>' + h.user + '</b>'+
                    '<div style="font-size:8.5px;color:#777;">' + h.method + ' • ' + h.time + ' WIB</div>'+
                '</div>'+
                '<div style="text-align:right;">'+
                    '<b style="color:var(--primary);">+' + h.coins + '</b>'+
                    '<div style="font-size:8.5px;color:#333;">$' + h.price + '</div>'+
                '</div>'+
            '</div>';
        }).join('');
    }
    historyModal.classList.add('show');
});

historyBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    historyModal.classList.remove('show');
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

Berikut adalah kode HTML lengkap yang sudah diubah ke mode potret (9:16) agar proporsional di layar HP maupun saat dibuka di desktop/tablet:

  • Bingkai Potret 9:16 (aspect-ratio: 9 / 16): .app-container diposisikan di tengah layar dengan rasio potret vertikal maksimal lebar 420px (dan sudut membulat rapi di layar lebih lebar).

  • Proporsi Atas–Bawah Lebih Seimbang: Bagian video atas menggunakan flex: 1 agar memanjang vertikal secara optimal, sedangkan bagian bawah (data target & isi ulang koin) diatur height: 36% dengan min-height: 245px dan max-height: 295px supaya tombol dan kartu koin tidak terpotong di layar potret.

  • Video Potret Penuh: #bgStreamVideo menggunakan object-fit: cover; object-position: center; agar video tampil penuh dalam bingkai potret.

code Html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#000000">
<title>Get Coins - TikTok Recharge</title>

<style>
/* =========================================
   ULTRA HD DISPLAY ENGINE & RESET
========================================= */
*{
    box-sizing:border-box;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
    text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}

html, body{
    width:100%;
    height:100dvh;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#000;
    font-family:Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    color:#222;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
}

button, input{font-family:inherit;}
button{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}

:root{
    --primary:#fe2c55;
    --sharp-text:#171717;
    --sharp-muted:#62676e;
    --sharp-border:#e6e8eb;
}

/* CONTAINER UTAMA MODE POTRET (9:16) */
.app-container{
    width:100%;
    height:100dvh;
    max-width:420px;
    margin:0 auto;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    background:#fff;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
}

@media (min-width: 480px){
    body{
        padding:16px 10px;
    }
    .app-container{
        width:auto;
        height:min(96dvh, 840px);
        aspect-ratio:9 / 16;
        min-width:min(100%, 340px);
        max-width:430px;
        border-radius:20px;
        box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
    }
}

/* ==========================================================
   1. BAGIAN ATAS: TEMPAT VIDEO POTRET
========================================================== */
.half-video-section{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    flex:1;
    min-height:0;
    background:#0c0d12;
    overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
}

#bgStreamVideo{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:cover;
    object-position:center;
    cursor:pointer;
}

/* Bar Header di Atas Video (Tanpa Badge LIVE) */
.video-overlay-bar{
    position:absolute;
    top:0;
    left:0;
    right:0;
    padding:9px 11px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), transparent);
    z-index:20;
    pointer-events:none;
}

.video-overlay-bar > *{
    pointer-events:auto;
}

/* Mini Player Musik dari Galeri */
.music-status-pill{
    display:none;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.58);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.55);
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:4px 8px;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    max-width:52%;
    min-width:0;
}

.music-status-pill.show{
    display:flex;
}

.music-title-text{
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
}

.music-mini-btn{
    background:none;
    border:none;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:700;
    cursor:pointer;
    padding:0 2px;
    line-height:1;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

.music-mini-btn.stop{
    color:#fe2c55;
}

.video-actions{
    margin-left:auto;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:7px;
    position:relative;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

.upload-icon-btn,
.menu-hamburger-btn{
    width:31px;
    height:31px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:15px;
    cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    transition:border-color .2s, color .2s, transform .12s;
}

.upload-icon-btn.sound-on{
    border-color:#38bdf8;
    color:#38bdf8;
    box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(56,189,248,0.45);
}

.upload-icon-btn.music-active{
    border-color:#22c55e;
    color:#22c55e;
    box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0.45);
}

.upload-icon-btn:active,
.menu-hamburger-btn:active{
    transform:scale(0.92);
}

.upload-icon-btn svg{
    width:15px;
    height:15px;
    stroke:currentColor;
    stroke-width:2;
    fill:none;
}

/* Dropdown Menu Garis 3 */
.header-menu-dropdown{
    display:none;
    position:absolute;
    top:37px;
    right:0;
    background:#ffffff;
    border-radius:10px;
    box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    min-width:190px;
    z-index:99;
    overflow:hidden;
}

.header-menu-dropdown.show{display:block;}

.header-menu-dropdown button{
    width:100%;
    padding:10px 12px;
    border:none;
    background:none;
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:#111;
    font-weight:600;
    text-align:left;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    cursor:pointer;
    border-bottom:1px solid #f2f3f5;
}
.header-menu-dropdown button:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.header-menu-dropdown button:active{background:#f8f9fa;}
.header-menu-dropdown button svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;}

/* ==========================================================
   2. BAGIAN BAWAH: WEB KOIN & TARGET AKUN
========================================================== */
.half-coins-section{
    width:100%;
    height:36%;
    min-height:245px;
    max-height:295px;
    background:#fff;
    display:flex;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
    border-top:2px solid var(--sharp-border);
    flex-shrink:0;
}

/* ---------------- SISI KIRI: DATA AKUN TARGET ---------------- */
.split-left-account{
    width:50%;
    height:100%;
    background:#ffffff;
    padding:7px 7px;
    border-right:1px solid var(--sharp-border);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    position:relative;
}
.split-left-account::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}

.pane-title{
    font-size:9.5px;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#8a8b91;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.3px;
    margin-bottom:5px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:4px;
}

.pane-title img{
    width:12px;
    height:12px;
}

/* Input Username Target TikTok */
.target-input-row{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    margin-bottom:5px;
}

.target-input-row input{
    width:100%;
    background:#fafafa;
    border:1px solid #dfe2e6;
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:5px 22px 5px 7px;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:500;
    color:#171717;
    outline:none;
}
.target-input-row input:focus{
    border-color:var(--primary);
    background:#fff;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(254,44,85,.08);
}

.target-spinner{
    display:none;
    position:absolute;
    right:6px;
    top:50%;
    transform:translateY(-50%);
    width:11px;
    height:11px;
    border:2px solid #ddd;
    border-top-color:var(--primary);
    border-radius:50%;
    animation:spin .65s linear infinite;
}
.target-spinner.show{display:block;}

@keyframes spin{to{transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(360deg);}}

.target-error-txt{
    display:none;
    color:#d93025;
    font-size:8.5px;
    margin-bottom:3px;
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
}

/* Card Profil Akun Target */
.account-preview-card{
    background:#fafafa;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:7px;
    padding:6px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    margin-bottom:5px;
}

.target-avatar-img{
    width:30px;
    height:30px;
    border-radius:50%;
    object-fit:cover;
    background:#eee;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

.account-details-box{
    min-width:0;
    flex:1;
}

.target-name-line{
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:750;
    color:#171717;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:3px;
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
}

.verified-badge-svg{
    width:11px;
    height:11px;
    flex-shrink:0;
    display:none;
}
.verified-badge-svg.show{display:inline-block;}

.target-uname-line{
    font-size:8.5px;
    color:#62676e;
    font-weight:500;
    white-space:nowrap;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
}

/* Bio Akun Target */
.target-bio-box{
    font-size:8.5px;
    color:#444950;
    background:#f8f9fa;
    border:1px solid #eceef0;
    border-radius:5px;
    padding:5px 6px;
    line-height:1.3;
    margin-bottom:2px;
    word-break:break-word;
    flex:1;
    overflow-y:auto;
}

/* ---------------- SISI KANAN: PROSES KOIN ---------------- */
.split-right-process{
    width:50%;
    height:100%;
    background:#ffffff;
    padding:7px 7px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    position:relative;
}
.split-right-process::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}

.recharge-heading-right h2{
    font-size:11px;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#171717;
    margin-bottom:1px;
}

.recharge-heading-right p{
    font-size:7.5px;
    color:#fe2c55;
    line-height:1.2;
    margin-bottom:5px;
}

/* Grid Pilihan Koin (Presisi 2 Kolom) */
.coins-grid-tight{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:3.5px;
    margin-bottom:5px;
}

/* Nominal Koin dibuat sedikit transparan */
.coin-chip{
    background:rgba(248, 249, 250, 0.65);
    border:1px solid rgba(225, 227, 230, 0.75);
    border-radius:5px;
    padding:4.5px 1px;
    color:#171717;
    cursor:pointer;
    text-align:center;
    transition:background .15s, border-color .15s, opacity .15s;
    opacity:0.82;
}

.coin-chip:hover{
    opacity:0.95;
}

.coin-chip.selected{
    background:rgba(255, 253, 246, 0.9);
    border-color:#e9ad00;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,193,7,.25);
    opacity:1;
}

.chip-top{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:2px;
    font-size:9.5px;
    font-weight:750;
    color:rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.85);
}
.chip-top img{
    width:10px;
    height:10px;
    opacity:0.88;
}

.chip-price{
    font-size:7.5px;
    color:rgba(119, 119, 119, 0.85);
    margin-top:1px;
}

/* AREA BAYAR & RINGKASAN */
.process-action-box{
    border-top:1px solid var(--sharp-border);
    padding-top:4px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:2.5px;
    margin-top:auto;
}

.special-offer-mini{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    font-size:7.5px;
    color:#62676e;
}
.special-offer-mini span:last-child{color:#fe2c55;font-weight:600;}

.summary-row-mini{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    font-size:8.5px;
    color:#666;
}
.summary-row-mini b{color:#171717;}

.buy-action-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:var(--primary);
    color:#fff;
    border:none;
    border-radius:5px;
    padding:6.5px 0;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:700;
    cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 1.5px 5px rgba(254,44,85,0.2);
    margin-top:2px;
}
.buy-action-btn:active{transform:scale(0.98);}

.right-center-card header{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    padding-bottom:3px;
    margin-bottom:3px;
    border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;
}
.right-center-card header h2{
    font-size:10.5px;
    font-weight:750;
    margin:0;
    color:#111;
}

.modal-close-sm{
    background:none;
    border:none;
    font-size:12px;
    cursor:pointer;
    color:#666;
    padding:0 2px;
}

/* Keypad Custom */
.coin-input-box-sm{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    border:1px solid #dfe2e6;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:2.5px 5px;
    margin:2px 0;
    background:#fff;
}
.coin-input-box-sm img{height:11.5px;margin-right:3px;}
.coin-input-box-sm input{border:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;width:100%;outline:none;}

.keypad-grid-sm{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:2.5px;
    margin:3px 0;
}
.keypad-grid-sm button{
    background:#f8f9fa;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:3px;
    padding:4px 0;
    font-size:9.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    cursor:pointer;
}

.btn-apply-sm{
    width:100%;
    padding:5.5px;
    border:none;
    border-radius:4px;
    background:var(--primary);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:10px;
    font-weight:750;
    cursor:pointer;
    margin-top:auto;
}

/* Pilihan Pembayaran */
.payment-choice-sm{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:3.5px 5px;
    margin-bottom:2px;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:8.5px;
    justify-content:space-between;
}
.payment-choice-sm.selected{
    background:#f5f9ff;
    border-color:#1677e8;
}

/* Loader TikTok */
.tiktok-loader-sm{
    position:relative;
    width:42px;
    height:22px;
    margin:4px auto;
}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot{
    position:absolute;
    width:17px;
    height:17px;
    border-radius:50%;
}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot.red{background:var(--primary);mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:moveRight .7s ease-in-out infinite;}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot.cyan{background:#00f2ea;mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:moveLeft .7s ease-in-out infinite;}

@keyframes moveLeft{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-10px) scale(.8)}}
@keyframes moveRight{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(10px) scale(.8)}}

/* ==========================================================
   POPUP OVERLAY INTERNAL PAS DI TENGAH WEB KANAN
========================================================== */
.right-inner-overlay{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    display:none;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    padding:5px;
    z-index:60;
    backdrop-filter:blur(2px);
}
.right-inner-overlay.show{display:flex;}

.right-center-card{
    background:#fff;
    width:100%;
    max-height:98%;
    border-radius:8px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    padding:7px 6px;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    animation:popInCenter .18s ease-out;
}
.right-center-card::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}

@keyframes popInCenter{
    from{transform:scale(0.88);opacity:0;}
    to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}
}

/* ==========================================================
   MODAL RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI (POPUP UMUM)
========================================================== */
.overlay-full{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    display:none;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    z-index:9999;
    padding:15px;
}
.overlay-full.show{display:flex;}

.modal-sheet{
    background:#fff;
    width:90%;
    max-width:320px;
    border-radius:14px;
    padding:14px;
    color:#171717;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="app-container">

    <!-- ==========================================================
         1. BAGIAN ATAS: TEMPAT VIDEO POTRET
    ========================================================== -->
    <div class="half-video-section">
        <video id="bgStreamVideo" autoplay loop muted playsinline>
            <source src="https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-young-woman-vlogger-recording-video-for-social-media-42777-large.mp4" type="video/mp4">
        </video>

        <!-- Overlay Bar di Atas Video (Tanpa Tanda LIVE) -->
        <div class="video-overlay-bar">
            <!-- Status Mini Musik dari Galeri -->
            <div class="music-status-pill" id="musicStatusPill">
                <span>🎵</span>
                <span class="music-title-text" id="musicTitleText">Musik</span>
                <button class="music-mini-btn" id="musicPlayPauseBtn" title="Putar / Jeda">⏸</button>
                <button class="music-mini-btn stop" id="musicStopBtn" title="Hentikan Musik">✕</button>
            </div>

            <div class="video-actions">
                <!-- Tombol Suara Video -->
                <button class="upload-icon-btn" id="soundToggleBtn" title="Nyalakan / Matikan Suara Video">
                    <svg id="iconSoundOff" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon>
                        <line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"></line>
                        <line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"></line>
                    </svg>
                    <svg id="iconSoundOn" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="display:none;">
                        <polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon>
                        <path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14"></path>
                        <path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"></path>
                    </svg>
                </button>

                <!-- Tombol Musik Galeri -->
                <button class="upload-icon-btn" id="musicBtn" title="Pilih Musik dari Galeri">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"></path>
                        <circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"></circle>
                        <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"></circle>
                    </svg>
                </button>

                <!-- Tombol Kamera Cepat -->
                <button class="upload-icon-btn" id="quickCameraBtn" title="Upload Video">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path d="M23 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2-3h6l2 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path>
                        <circle cx="12" cy="13" r="4"></circle>
                    </svg>
                </button>

                <!-- Tombol Garis 3 Menu -->
                <button class="menu-hamburger-btn" id="menuBtn" title="Menu">☰</button>

                <!-- Dropdown Menu -->
                <div class="header-menu-dropdown" id="menuDropdown">
                    <button id="menuUploadVideo">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M19 4H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v12a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2m0 14H5V8h14v10m-7-2l3-4 2 2.5 3-3.8 4 5.3H6l4-5.3 2 2.3Z"/></svg>
                        Upload Video (Galeri / Kamera)
                    </button>
                    <button id="menuUploadMusic">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 3v10.55A4 4 0 1 0 14 17V7h4V3h-6Z"/></svg>
                        Putar Musik dari Galeri
                    </button>
                    <button id="menuRiwayat">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M13 3a9 9 0 0 0-9 9H1l3.89 3.89.07.14L9 12H6c0-3.87 3.13-7 7-7s7 3.13 7 7-3.13 7-7 7c-1.93 0-3.68-.79-4.94-2.06l-1.42 1.42A8.954 8.954 0 0 0 13 21a9 9 0 0 0 9-9 9 9 0 0 0-9-9m-1 5v5l4.28 2.54.72-1.21-3.5-2.08V8H12Z"/></svg>
                        Riwayat Transaksi
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Input File Video & Musik Tersembunyi -->
        <input type="file" id="videoFileInput" accept="video/*" style="display:none;">
        <input type="file" id="musicFileInput" accept="audio/*,.mp3,.m4a,.wav,.aac,.ogg" style="display:none;">
        <audio id="bgMusicAudio" loop playsinline></audio>
    </div>

    <!-- ==========================================================
         2. BAGIAN BAWAH: WEB KOIN & TARGET AKUN
    ========================================================== -->
    <div class="half-coins-section">

        <!-- SISI KIRI: DATA AKUN TARGET -->
        <div class="split-left-account">
            <div class="pane-title">
                <img src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="TikTok">
                <span>Account TikTok</span>
            </div>

            <!-- Input Username Target TikTok -->
            <div class="target-input-row">
                <input id="targetUsernameInput" type="text" placeholder="Username TikTok..." autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
                <span id="topTargetSpinner" class="target-spinner"></span>
            </div>
            <div id="targetStatus" class="target-error-txt"></div>

            <!-- Kartu Profil Target -->
            <div class="account-preview-card">

                <div class="account-details-box">

                <!-- 350 Coins -->

                <!-- Custom -->
                <div class="coin-chip" id="btnOpenCustomModal">

            <!-- AREA BAYAR & RINGKASAN -->

            <!-- 1. POPUP INPUT MANUAL / CUSTOM -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="customModal">
                <div class="right-center-card">
                    <header>
                        <h2>Custom</h2>

                    <div class="coin-input-box-sm">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" alt="c">
                        <input id="coinAmountInput" type="text" value="0" readonly>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px;" id="usdAmountDisplay">$0.00</div>

                    <div class="keypad-grid-sm" id="keypad">
                        <button>1</button><button>2</button><button>3</button><button>⌫</button>
                        <button>4</button><button>5</button><button>6</button><button>000</button>
                        <button>7</button><button>8</button><button>9</button><button>0</button>
                    </div>

                    <button class="btn-apply-sm" id="rechargeBtn">Recharge</button>
                </div>

            <!-- 2. POPUP KETERANGAN PEMBELIAN -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="orderModal">
                <div class="right-center-card">
                    <header>
                        <h2>Order summary</h2>

                        <b>✓</b>
                    </div>
                    <div class="payment-choice-sm" data-method="Mastercard">
                        <span>Mastercard</span>
                        <b></b>
                    </div>

                    <button class="btn-apply-sm" id="payNowBtn" style="margin-top:auto;">Pay now</button>
                </div>

            <!-- 3. POPUP PROSES LOADER -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="loaderModal">
                <div class="right-center-card" style="text-align:center;justify-content:center;padding:9px 6px;">
                    <div class="tiktok-loader-sm">
                        <div class="dot red"></div>
                        <div class="dot cyan"></div>
                    </div>
                    <p id="processingMessage" style="font-size:9px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;color:#555;">Processing payment...</p>
                    <p id="countdownTimer" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--primary);font-weight:800;margin-top:2px;">00:03</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 4. POPUP BERHASIL / SUKSES DENGAN FOTO PROFIL & USERNAME TARGET -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="successModal">
                <div class="right-center-card" style="text-align:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 6px;">
                    <h2 style="font-size:11px;color:var(--primary);margin-bottom:4px;">Successful recharge!</h2>
                    
                    <!-- Kartu Avatar & Username Target -->
                    <div style="background:#f8f9fa;border:1px solid #edf0f2;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-bottom:4px;text-align:left;">
                        <img id="successTargetAvatar" src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="Avatar" style="width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#eee;border:1px solid #dfe2e6;flex-shrink:0;">
                        <div style="min-width:0;flex:1;">
                            <div id="successTargetName" style="font-size:9px;font-weight:750;color:#171717;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">-</div>
                            <div id="successTargetUsername" style="font-size:7.5px;color:#62676e;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">@username</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px;">
                        <img src="https://tikpopular.com/wp-content/coins.png" style="width:13px;" alt="c">
                        <span id="successCoinsText">30 Coins</span>
                    </div>

                    <p style="font-size:7.5px;color:#62676e;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:5px;">
                        Coins successfully added to account.
                    </p>
                    <button class="btn-apply-sm" id="goBackBtn">Done</button>
