</div>

<!-- ==========================================================
     MODAL RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI (POPUP UMUM)
========================================================== -->
<div class="overlay-full" id="historyModal">
    <div class="modal-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:750;font-size:13px;">
            <span>Riwayat Transaksi</span>
            <span style="cursor:pointer;" id="historyBackBtn">✕</span>
        </div>
        <div id="historyList" style="max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;font-size:10.5px;">
            <div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:20px 0;">Belum ada riwayat transaksi.</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
/* ========================================================
   1. DETEKSI & RESET AKUN TIKTOK (API TIKWM LENGKAP)
======================================================== */
var targetUsernameInput = document.getElementById('targetUsernameInput');
var topTargetSpinner = document.getElementById('topTargetSpinner');
var targetStatus = document.getElementById('targetStatus');
var targetAvatar = document.getElementById('targetAvatar');
var targetName = document.getElementById('targetName');
var targetVerifiedBadge = document.getElementById('targetVerifiedBadge');
var targetUsername = document.getElementById('targetUsername');
var targetBio = document.getElementById('targetBio');

var detectedTarget = null;
var targetDetectTimer = null;
var targetRequestId = 0;
var lastDetectedValue = '';

function normalizeInput(v){
    v = String(v||'').trim();
    if(!v) return '';
    v = v.replace(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.|m\.)?tiktok\.com\//i,'');
    v = v.replace(/^@/,'');
    return v.split(/[/?#]/)[0].trim();
}

function renderAccount(data){
    detectedTarget = data;

    targetAvatar.src = data.avatar || '';
    targetAvatar.onerror = function(){
        targetAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
    };

    targetName.textContent = data.name || data.username;
    targetUsername.textContent = '@' + data.username;

    if(data.verified) targetVerifiedBadge.classList.add('show');
    else targetVerifiedBadge.classList.remove('show');

    targetBio.textContent = data.bio || 'No bio yet.';

    targetStatus.style.display = 'none';
}

function resetTarget(){
    clearTimeout(targetDetectTimer);
    targetRequestId++;

    detectedTarget = null;
    lastDetectedValue = '';

    targetUsernameInput.value = '';
    topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');

    targetStatus.textContent = '';
    targetStatus.style.display = 'none';

    targetName.textContent = '-';
    targetUsername.textContent = '-';
    targetVerifiedBadge.classList.remove('show');

    targetBio.textContent = 'Enter your TikTok username account...';

    targetAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';

    coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
    var defChip = document.querySelector('.coin-chip[data-coins="30"]');
    if(defChip) defChip.classList.add('selected');

    selectedCoins = 30;
    selectedPrice = 0.31;
    customStr = '0';
    coinAmountInput.value = '0';
    usdAmountDisplay.textContent = '$0.00';
    updateCoinDisplays();
    resetCustomButtonState();
}

function queryTikTok(username){
    var requestId = ++targetRequestId;
    topTargetSpinner.classList.add('show');

    fetch('https://www.tikwm.com/api/user/info/', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body:'unique_id=' + encodeURIComponent(username)
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(j => {
        if(requestId !== targetRequestId) return;
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');

        if(j.code === 0 && j.data){
            var u = j.data.user || {};
            lastDetectedValue = username.toLowerCase();
            renderAccount({
                username: u.uniqueId || username,
                name: u.nickname || username,
                avatar: u.avatarLarger || u.avatarThumb || '',
                bio: u.signature || '',
                verified: !!u.verified
            });
        } else {
            targetStatus.textContent = 'Akun tidak ditemukan.';
            targetStatus.style.display = 'block';
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        if(requestId !== targetRequestId) return;
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        targetStatus.textContent = 'Gagal memuat akun.';
        targetStatus.style.display = 'block';
    });
}

targetUsernameInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
    clearTimeout(targetDetectTimer);
    var u = normalizeInput(targetUsernameInput.value);
    if(!u){
        resetTarget();
        return;
    }
    if(u.toLowerCase() === lastDetectedValue){
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        return;
    }
    targetDetectTimer = setTimeout(function(){
        queryTikTok(u);
    }, 700);
});

/* ========================================================
   2. MENU GARIS TIGA: SUARA VIDEO, UPLOAD VIDEO & MUSIK GALERI
======================================================== */
var menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
var menuDropdown = document.getElementById('menuDropdown');
var menuToggleSound = document.getElementById('menuToggleSound');
var menuSoundIconOff = document.getElementById('menuSoundIconOff');
var menuSoundIconOn = document.getElementById('menuSoundIconOn');
var menuSoundLabel = document.getElementById('menuSoundLabel');
var menuUploadVideo = document.getElementById('menuUploadVideo');
var menuUploadMusic = document.getElementById('menuUploadMusic');

var videoFileInput = document.getElementById('videoFileInput');
var bgStreamVideo = document.getElementById('bgStreamVideo');

var musicFileInput = document.getElementById('musicFileInput');
var bgMusicAudio = document.getElementById('bgMusicAudio');
var musicStatusPill = document.getElementById('musicStatusPill');
var musicPlayPauseBtn = document.getElementById('musicPlayPauseBtn');
var musicStopBtn = document.getElementById('musicStopBtn');

var currentVideoUrl = null;
var currentMusicUrl = null;

function updateSoundMenuUI(isUnmuted){
    if(isUnmuted){
        menuToggleSound.classList.add('sound-active');
        menuSoundIconOff.style.display = 'none';
        menuSoundIconOn.style.display = 'block';
        menuSoundLabel.textContent = 'Matikan Suara Video';
    } else {
        menuToggleSound.classList.remove('sound-active');
        menuSoundIconOff.style.display = 'block';
        menuSoundIconOn.style.display = 'none';
        menuSoundLabel.textContent = 'Nyalakan Suara Video';
    }
}

function toggleVideoSound(){
    var nextUnmute = bgStreamVideo.muted;
    bgStreamVideo.muted = !nextUnmute;
    bgStreamVideo.volume = 1;
    bgStreamVideo.play().catch(function(){});
    updateSoundMenuUI(nextUnmute);
}

menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    menuDropdown.classList.toggle('show');
});

document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(!menuDropdown.contains(e.target) && e.target !== menuBtn){
        menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    }
});

menuToggleSound.addEventListener('click', function(){
    toggleVideoSound();
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
});

bgStreamVideo.addEventListener('click', function(){
    toggleVideoSound();
});

menuUploadVideo.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    videoFileInput.click();
});

videoFileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var file = e.target.files[0];
    if(!file) return;

    if(file.type.startsWith('video/')){
        if(currentVideoUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentVideoUrl);
        currentVideoUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        bgStreamVideo.src = currentVideoUrl;
        bgStreamVideo.load();
        bgStreamVideo.muted = false;
        bgStreamVideo.volume = 1;
        bgStreamVideo.play().then(function(){
            updateSoundMenuUI(true);
        }).catch(function(){
            bgStreamVideo.muted = true;
            bgStreamVideo.play().catch(function(){});
            updateSoundMenuUI(false);
        });
    } else {
        alert('Pilih file berformat video.');
    }
    videoFileInput.value = '';
});

menuUploadMusic.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    musicFileInput.click();
});

musicFileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var file = e.target.files[0];
    if(!file) return;

    if(currentMusicUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentMusicUrl);
    currentMusicUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    bgMusicAudio.src = currentMusicUrl;
    bgMusicAudio.muted = false;
    bgMusicAudio.volume = 1;
    bgMusicAudio.load();

    musicStatusPill.classList.add('show');

    bgMusicAudio.play().then(function(){
        menuBtn.classList.add('music-active');
        musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '⏸';
    }).catch(function(){
        menuBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
        musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '▶';
    });

    musicFileInput.value = '';
});

musicPlayPauseBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(!bgMusicAudio.src) return;
    if(bgMusicAudio.paused){
        bgMusicAudio.play().then(function(){
            menuBtn.classList.add('music-active');
            musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '⏸';
        }).catch(function(){});
    } else {
        bgMusicAudio.pause();
        menuBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
        musicPlayPauseBtn.textContent = '▶';
    }
});

musicStopBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    bgMusicAudio.pause();
    bgMusicAudio.currentTime = 0;
    bgMusicAudio.removeAttribute('src');
    bgMusicAudio.load();
    if(currentMusicUrl){
        URL.revokeObjectURL(currentMusicUrl);
        currentMusicUrl = null;
    }
    musicStatusPill.classList.remove('show');
    menuBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
});

/* ========================================================
   3. SELEKSI KOIN & MODAL CUSTOM
======================================================== */
var selectedCoins = 30;
var selectedPrice = 0.31;

var summaryPriceDisplay = document.getElementById('summaryPriceDisplay');
var btnBuyRecharge = document.getElementById('btnBuyRecharge');
var coinChips = document.querySelectorAll('.coin-chip:not(#btnOpenCustomModal)');

function updateCoinDisplays(){
    var pStr = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);
    summaryPriceDisplay.textContent = pStr;
    btnBuyRecharge.textContent = 'Buy for ' + pStr;
}

coinChips.forEach(function(chip){
    chip.addEventListener('click', function(){
        coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
        document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal').classList.remove('selected');
        chip.classList.add('selected');

        selectedCoins = parseInt(chip.getAttribute('data-coins'));
        selectedPrice = parseFloat(chip.getAttribute('data-price'));
        updateCoinDisplays();
    });
});

var customModal = document.getElementById('customModal');
var btnOpenCustomModal = document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal');
var modalBackBtn = document.getElementById('modalBackBtn');
var coinAmountInput = document.getElementById('coinAmountInput');
var usdAmountDisplay = document.getElementById('usdAmountDisplay');
var keypad = document.getElementById('keypad');
var rechargeBtn = document.getElementById('rechargeBtn');

var customStr = '0';

function resetCustomButtonState(){
    document.getElementById('customChipTxt').textContent = 'Custom';
    document.getElementById('customChipPrice').textContent = 'Large amount supported';
    document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal').classList.remove('selected');
}

btnOpenCustomModal.addEventListener('click', function(){
    customModal.classList.add('show');
});
modalBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    customModal.classList.remove('show');
});

keypad.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var b = e.target.closest('button');
    if(!b) return;
    var v = b.textContent;
    var n = parseInt(customStr) || 0;

    if(v === '⌫'){
        var s = String(n).slice(0, -1);
        n = s === '' ? 0 : parseInt(s);
    } else if(v === '000'){
        n = n * 1000;
    } else {
        n = n * 10 + parseInt(v);
    }

    if(n > 2500000) n = 2500000;
    customStr = String(n);
    coinAmountInput.value = n.toLocaleString('en-US');
    var usd = (n * 0.010357).toFixed(2);
    usdAmountDisplay.textContent = '$' + usd;
});

rechargeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var n = parseInt(customStr) || 0;
    if(n < 30) n = 30;
    selectedCoins = n;
    selectedPrice = parseFloat((n * 0.010357).toFixed(2));

    coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
    btnOpenCustomModal.classList.add('selected');

    document.getElementById('customChipTxt').textContent = n.toLocaleString('en-US');
    document.getElementById('customChipPrice').textContent = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);

    updateCoinDisplays();
    customModal.classList.remove('show');
});

======================================================== */
var orderModal = document.getElementById('orderModal');
var summaryBackBtn = document.getElementById('summaryBackBtn');
var payNowBtn = document.getElementById('payNowBtn');
var selectedMethod = 'Visa';

btnBuyRecharge.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var dName = detectedTarget ? (detectedTarget.name || '@' + detectedTarget.username) : 'Guest';
    document.getElementById('accountName').textContent = dName;
    document.getElementById('summaryCoins').textContent = Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' Coins';
    document.getElementById('summaryPrice').textContent = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);
    orderModal.classList.add('show');
});

summaryBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    orderModal.classList.remove('show');
});

document.querySelectorAll('.payment-choice-sm').forEach(function(opt){
    opt.addEventListener('click', function(){
        document.querySelectorAll('.payment-choice-sm').forEach(o => {
            o.classList.remove('selected');
            o.querySelector('b').textContent = '';
        });
        opt.classList.add('selected');
        opt.querySelector('b').textContent = '✓';
        selectedMethod = opt.getAttribute('data-method');
    });
});

/* ========================================================
   5. ANIMASI LOADER & SUKSES
======================================================== */
var loaderModal = document.getElementById('loaderModal');
var successModal = document.getElementById('successModal');
var countdownTimer = document.getElementById('countdownTimer');
var historyStore = [];

payNowBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    orderModal.classList.remove('show');
    loaderModal.classList.add('show');

    var secs = 3;
    countdownTimer.textContent = '00:03';

    var iv = setInterval(function(){
        secs--;
        countdownTimer.textContent = '00:0' + secs;
        if(secs <= 0){
            clearInterval(iv);
            loaderModal.classList.remove('show');

            document.getElementById('successCoinsText').textContent = Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' Coins';
            
            /* Tampilkan Foto Profil & Username Target di Pop-up Sukses */
            var sAvatar = document.getElementById('successTargetAvatar');
            var sName = document.getElementById('successTargetName');
            var sUname = document.getElementById('successTargetUsername');

            if(detectedTarget){
                sAvatar.src = detectedTarget.avatar || 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
                sName.textContent = detectedTarget.name || detectedTarget.username;
                sUname.textContent = '@' + detectedTarget.username;
            } else {
                sAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
                sName.textContent = 'TikTok Account';
                sUname.textContent = '@tiktok';
            }
            sAvatar.onerror = function(){
                this.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
            };

            successModal.classList.add('show');

            historyStore.unshift({
                user: detectedTarget ? ('@' + detectedTarget.username) : 'Guest',
                coins: Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US'),
                price: selectedPrice.toFixed(2),
                method: selectedMethod,
                time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})
            });
        }
    }, 1000);
});

function clearAccountAfterSuccess(){
    successModal.classList.remove('show');
    resetTarget();
    targetUsernameInput.focus();
}

document.getElementById('goBackBtn').addEventListener('click', clearAccountAfterSuccess);

/* ========================================================
   6. RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI
======================================================== */
var menuRiwayat = document.getElementById('menuRiwayat');
var historyModal = document.getElementById('historyModal');
var historyBackBtn = document.getElementById('historyBackBtn');
var historyList = document.getElementById('historyList');

menuRiwayat.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    if(historyStore.length === 0){
        historyList.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:20px 0;">Belum ada riwayat transaksi.</div>';
    } else {
        historyList.innerHTML = historyStore.map(function(h){
            return '<div style="background:#f8f9fa;border-radius:6px;padding:6px;margin-bottom:5px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'+
                '<div>'+
                    '<b>' + h.user + '</b>'+
                    '<div style="font-size:8.5px;color:#777;">' + h.method + ' • ' + h.time + ' WIB</div>'+
                '</div>'+
                '<div style="text-align:right;">'+
                    '<b style="color:var(--primary);">+' + h.coins + '</b>'+
                    '<div style="font-size:8.5px;color:#333;">$' + h.price + '</div>'+
                '</div>'+
            '</div>';
        }).join('');
    }
    historyModal.classList.add('show');
});

historyBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    historyModal.classList.remove('show');
});
</script>

    gap:2px;
    margin:2px 0;
}
.keypad-grid-sm button{
    background:#f8f9fa;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:3px;
    padding:3px 0;
    font-size:8.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    cursor:pointer;
}

.btn-apply-sm{
    width:100%;
    padding:4.5px;
    border:none;
    border-radius:4px;
    background:var(--primary);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:9px;
    font-weight:750;
    cursor:pointer;
    margin-top:auto;
}

/* Pilihan Pembayaran */
.payment-choice-sm{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    border:1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:3px 5px;
    margin-bottom:2px;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:8px;
    justify-content:space-between;
}
.payment-choice-sm.selected{
    background:#f5f9ff;
    border-color:#1677e8;
}

/* Loader TikTok */
.tiktok-loader-sm{
    position:relative;
    width:38px;
    height:20px;
    margin:3px auto;
}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot{
    position:absolute;
    width:15px;
    height:15px;
    border-radius:50%;
}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot.red{background:var(--primary);mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:moveRight .7s ease-in-out infinite;}
.tiktok-loader-sm .dot.cyan{background:#00f2ea;mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:moveLeft .7s ease-in-out infinite;}

@keyframes moveLeft{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-9px) scale(.8)}}
@keyframes moveRight{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(9px) scale(.8)}}

/* ==========================================================
   POPUP OVERLAY INTERNAL PAS DI TENGAH WEB KANAN
========================================================== */
.right-inner-overlay{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    display:none;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    padding:4px;
    z-index:60;
    backdrop-filter:blur(2px);
}
.right-inner-overlay.show{display:flex;}

.right-center-card{
    background:#fff;
    width:100%;
    max-height:98%;
    border-radius:7px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    padding:5px 5px;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none;
    animation:popInCenter .18s ease-out;
}
.right-center-card::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}

@keyframes popInCenter{
    from{transform:scale(0.88);opacity:0;}
    to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;}
}

/* ==========================================================
   MODAL RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI (POPUP UMUM)
========================================================== */
.overlay-full{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    display:none;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:center;
    z-index:9999;
    padding:15px;
}
.overlay-full.show{display:flex;}

.modal-sheet{
    background:#fff;
    width:90%;
    max-width:320px;
    border-radius:14px;
    padding:14px;
    color:#171717;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="app-container">

    <!-- ==========================================================
         1. BAGIAN ATAS: TEMPAT VIDEO POTRET
    ========================================================== -->
    <div class="half-video-section">
        <video id="bgStreamVideo" autoplay loop muted playsinline>
            <source src="https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-young-woman-vlogger-recording-video-for-social-media-42777-large.mp4" type="video/mp4">
        </video>

        <!-- Overlay Bar di Atas Video (Semua Kontrol Ada di Menu Garis 3) -->

            <div class="video-actions">

                <!-- Dropdown Menu -->
                <div class="header-menu-dropdown" id="menuDropdown">

                        <svg id="menuSoundIconOff" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">

                        <svg id="menuSoundIconOn" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="display:none;">

                        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M13 3a9 9 0 0 0-9 9H1l3.89 3.89.07.14L9 12H6c0-3.87 3.13-7 7-7s7 3.13 7 7-3.13 7-7 7c-1.93 0-3.68-.79-4.94-2.06l-1.42 1.42A8.954 8.954 0 0 0 13 21a9 9 0 0 0 9-9 9 9 0 0 0-9-9m-1 5v5l4.28 2.54.72-1.21-3.5-2.08V8H12Z"/></svg>

            <!-- 1. POPUP INPUT MANUAL / CUSTOM -->

            <!-- 4. POPUP BERHASIL / SUKSES DENGAN FOTO PROFIL & USERNAME TARGET -->
            <div class="right-inner-overlay" id="successModal">

                    <!-- Kartu Avatar & Username Target -->
                    <div style="background:#f8f9fa;border:1px solid #edf0f2;border-radius:6px;padding:3.5px 5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-bottom:3px;text-align:left;">
                        <img id="successTargetAvatar" src="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png" alt="Avatar" style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#eee;border:1px solid #dfe2e6;flex-shrink:0;">

</div>

<!-- ==========================================================
     MODAL RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI (POPUP UMUM)
========================================================== -->
<div class="overlay-full" id="historyModal">
    <div class="modal-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:750;font-size:13px;">
            <span>Riwayat Transaksi</span>
            <span style="cursor:pointer;" id="historyBackBtn">✕</span>
        </div>
        <div id="historyList" style="max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;font-size:10.5px;">
            <div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:20px 0;">Belum ada riwayat transaksi.</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
/* ========================================================
   1. DETEKSI & RESET AKUN TIKTOK (API TIKWM LENGKAP)
======================================================== */
var targetUsernameInput = document.getElementById('targetUsernameInput');
var topTargetSpinner = document.getElementById('topTargetSpinner');
var targetStatus = document.getElementById('targetStatus');
var targetAvatar = document.getElementById('targetAvatar');
var targetName = document.getElementById('targetName');
var targetVerifiedBadge = document.getElementById('targetVerifiedBadge');
var targetUsername = document.getElementById('targetUsername');
var targetBio = document.getElementById('targetBio');

var detectedTarget = null;
var targetDetectTimer = null;
var targetRequestId = 0;
var lastDetectedValue = '';

function normalizeInput(v){
    v = String(v||'').trim();
    if(!v) return '';
    v = v.replace(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.|m\.)?tiktok\.com\//i,'');
    v = v.replace(/^@/,'');
    return v.split(/[/?#]/)[0].trim();
}

function renderAccount(data){
    detectedTarget = data;

    targetAvatar.src = data.avatar || '';
    targetAvatar.onerror = function(){
        targetAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
    };

    targetName.textContent = data.name || data.username;
    targetUsername.textContent = '@' + data.username;

    if(data.verified) targetVerifiedBadge.classList.add('show');
    else targetVerifiedBadge.classList.remove('show');

    targetBio.textContent = data.bio || 'No bio yet.';

    targetStatus.style.display = 'none';
}

function resetTarget(){
    clearTimeout(targetDetectTimer);
    targetRequestId++;

    detectedTarget = null;
    lastDetectedValue = '';

    targetUsernameInput.value = '';
    topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');

    targetStatus.textContent = '';
    targetStatus.style.display = 'none';

    targetName.textContent = '-';
    targetUsername.textContent = '-';
    targetVerifiedBadge.classList.remove('show');

    targetBio.textContent = 'Enter your TikTok username account...';

    targetAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';

    coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
    var defChip = document.querySelector('.coin-chip[data-coins="30"]');
    if(defChip) defChip.classList.add('selected');

    selectedCoins = 30;
    selectedPrice = 0.31;
    customStr = '0';
    coinAmountInput.value = '0';
    usdAmountDisplay.textContent = '$0.00';
    updateCoinDisplays();
    resetCustomButtonState();
}

function queryTikTok(username){
    var requestId = ++targetRequestId;
    topTargetSpinner.classList.add('show');

    fetch('https://www.tikwm.com/api/user/info/', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body:'unique_id=' + encodeURIComponent(username)
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(j => {
        if(requestId !== targetRequestId) return;
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');

        if(j.code === 0 && j.data){
            var u = j.data.user || {};
            lastDetectedValue = username.toLowerCase();
            renderAccount({
                username: u.uniqueId || username,
                name: u.nickname || username,
                avatar: u.avatarLarger || u.avatarThumb || '',
                bio: u.signature || '',
                verified: !!u.verified
            });
        } else {
            targetStatus.textContent = 'Akun tidak ditemukan.';
            targetStatus.style.display = 'block';
        }
    })
    .catch(() => {
        if(requestId !== targetRequestId) return;
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        targetStatus.textContent = 'Gagal memuat akun.';
        targetStatus.style.display = 'block';
    });
}

targetUsernameInput.addEventListener('input', function(){
    clearTimeout(targetDetectTimer);
    var u = normalizeInput(targetUsernameInput.value);
    if(!u){
        resetTarget();
        return;
    }
    if(u.toLowerCase() === lastDetectedValue){
        topTargetSpinner.classList.remove('show');
        return;
    }
    targetDetectTimer = setTimeout(function(){
        queryTikTok(u);
    }, 700);
});

/* ========================================================
   2. MENU GARIS TIGA: SUARA VIDEO, UPLOAD VIDEO & MUSIK GALERI
======================================================== */
var menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
var menuDropdown = document.getElementById('menuDropdown');
var menuToggleSound = document.getElementById('menuToggleSound');
var menuSoundIconOff = document.getElementById('menuSoundIconOff');
var menuSoundIconOn = document.getElementById('menuSoundIconOn');
var menuSoundLabel = document.getElementById('menuSoundLabel');
var menuUploadVideo = document.getElementById('menuUploadVideo');
var menuUploadMusic = document.getElementById('menuUploadMusic');
var menuMusicPlayPause = document.getElementById('menuMusicPlayPause');
var menuMusicPauseIcon = document.getElementById('menuMusicPauseIcon');
var menuMusicPlayIcon = document.getElementById('menuMusicPlayIcon');
var menuMusicPlayPauseLabel = document.getElementById('menuMusicPlayPauseLabel');
var menuMusicStop = document.getElementById('menuMusicStop');

var videoFileInput = document.getElementById('videoFileInput');
var bgStreamVideo = document.getElementById('bgStreamVideo');

var musicFileInput = document.getElementById('musicFileInput');
var bgMusicAudio = document.getElementById('bgMusicAudio');

var currentVideoUrl = null;
var currentMusicUrl = null;

function updateSoundMenuUI(isUnmuted){
    if(isUnmuted){
        menuToggleSound.classList.add('sound-active');
        menuSoundIconOff.style.display = 'none';
        menuSoundIconOn.style.display = 'block';
        menuSoundLabel.textContent = 'Matikan Suara Video';
    } else {
        menuToggleSound.classList.remove('sound-active');
        menuSoundIconOff.style.display = 'block';
        menuSoundIconOn.style.display = 'none';
        menuSoundLabel.textContent = 'Nyalakan Suara Video';
    }
}

function updateMusicMenuUI(isPlaying){
    if(isPlaying){
        menuBtn.classList.add('music-active');
        menuMusicPauseIcon.style.display = 'block';
        menuMusicPlayIcon.style.display = 'none';
        menuMusicPlayPauseLabel.textContent = 'Jeda Musik';
    } else {
        menuBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
        menuMusicPauseIcon.style.display = 'none';
        menuMusicPlayIcon.style.display = 'block';
        menuMusicPlayPauseLabel.textContent = 'Putar Musik';
    }
}

function toggleVideoSound(){
    var nextUnmute = bgStreamVideo.muted;
    bgStreamVideo.muted = !nextUnmute;
    bgStreamVideo.volume = 1;
    bgStreamVideo.play().catch(function(){});
    updateSoundMenuUI(nextUnmute);
}

menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    menuDropdown.classList.toggle('show');
});

document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(!menuDropdown.contains(e.target) && e.target !== menuBtn){
        menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    }
});

menuToggleSound.addEventListener('click', function(){
    toggleVideoSound();
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
});

bgStreamVideo.addEventListener('click', function(){
    toggleVideoSound();
});

menuUploadVideo.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    videoFileInput.click();
});

videoFileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var file = e.target.files[0];
    if(!file) return;

    if(file.type.startsWith('video/')){
        if(currentVideoUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentVideoUrl);
        currentVideoUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        bgStreamVideo.src = currentVideoUrl;
        bgStreamVideo.load();
        bgStreamVideo.muted = false;
        bgStreamVideo.volume = 1;
        bgStreamVideo.play().then(function(){
            updateSoundMenuUI(true);
        }).catch(function(){
            bgStreamVideo.muted = true;
            bgStreamVideo.play().catch(function(){});
            updateSoundMenuUI(false);
        });
    } else {
        alert('Pilih file berformat video.');
    }
    videoFileInput.value = '';
});

menuUploadMusic.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    musicFileInput.click();
});

musicFileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var file = e.target.files[0];
    if(!file) return;

    if(currentMusicUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentMusicUrl);
    currentMusicUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    bgMusicAudio.src = currentMusicUrl;
    bgMusicAudio.muted = false;
    bgMusicAudio.volume = 1;
    bgMusicAudio.load();

    menuMusicPlayPause.style.display = 'flex';
    menuMusicStop.style.display = 'flex';

    bgMusicAudio.play().then(function(){
        updateMusicMenuUI(true);
    }).catch(function(){
        updateMusicMenuUI(false);
    });

    musicFileInput.value = '';
});

menuMusicPlayPause.addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(!bgMusicAudio.src) return;
    if(bgMusicAudio.paused){
        bgMusicAudio.play().then(function(){
            updateMusicMenuUI(true);
        }).catch(function(){});
    } else {
        bgMusicAudio.pause();
        updateMusicMenuUI(false);
    }
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
});

menuMusicStop.addEventListener('click', function(){
    bgMusicAudio.pause();
    bgMusicAudio.currentTime = 0;
    bgMusicAudio.removeAttribute('src');
    bgMusicAudio.load();
    if(currentMusicUrl){
        URL.revokeObjectURL(currentMusicUrl);
        currentMusicUrl = null;
    }
    menuMusicPlayPause.style.display = 'none';
    menuMusicStop.style.display = 'none';
    menuBtn.classList.remove('music-active');
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
});

/* ========================================================
   3. SELEKSI KOIN & MODAL CUSTOM
======================================================== */
var selectedCoins = 30;
var selectedPrice = 0.31;

var summaryPriceDisplay = document.getElementById('summaryPriceDisplay');
var btnBuyRecharge = document.getElementById('btnBuyRecharge');
var coinChips = document.querySelectorAll('.coin-chip:not(#btnOpenCustomModal)');

function updateCoinDisplays(){
    var pStr = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);
    summaryPriceDisplay.textContent = pStr;
    btnBuyRecharge.textContent = 'Buy for ' + pStr;
}

coinChips.forEach(function(chip){
    chip.addEventListener('click', function(){
        coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
        document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal').classList.remove('selected');
        chip.classList.add('selected');

        selectedCoins = parseInt(chip.getAttribute('data-coins'));
        selectedPrice = parseFloat(chip.getAttribute('data-price'));
        updateCoinDisplays();
    });
});

var customModal = document.getElementById('customModal');
var btnOpenCustomModal = document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal');
var modalBackBtn = document.getElementById('modalBackBtn');
var coinAmountInput = document.getElementById('coinAmountInput');
var usdAmountDisplay = document.getElementById('usdAmountDisplay');
var keypad = document.getElementById('keypad');
var rechargeBtn = document.getElementById('rechargeBtn');

var customStr = '0';

function resetCustomButtonState(){
    document.getElementById('customChipTxt').textContent = 'Custom';
    document.getElementById('customChipPrice').textContent = 'Large amount supported';
    document.getElementById('btnOpenCustomModal').classList.remove('selected');
}

btnOpenCustomModal.addEventListener('click', function(){
    customModal.classList.add('show');
});
modalBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    customModal.classList.remove('show');
});

keypad.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var b = e.target.closest('button');
    if(!b) return;
    var v = b.textContent;
    var n = parseInt(customStr) || 0;

    if(v === '⌫'){
        var s = String(n).slice(0, -1);
        n = s === '' ? 0 : parseInt(s);
    } else if(v === '000'){
        n = n * 1000;
    } else {
        n = n * 10 + parseInt(v);
    }

    if(n > 2500000) n = 2500000;
    customStr = String(n);
    coinAmountInput.value = n.toLocaleString('en-US');
    var usd = (n * 0.010357).toFixed(2);
    usdAmountDisplay.textContent = '$' + usd;
});

rechargeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var n = parseInt(customStr) || 0;
    if(n < 30) n = 30;
    selectedCoins = n;
    selectedPrice = parseFloat((n * 0.010357).toFixed(2));

    coinChips.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
    btnOpenCustomModal.classList.add('selected');

    document.getElementById('customChipTxt').textContent = n.toLocaleString('en-US');
    document.getElementById('customChipPrice').textContent = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);

    updateCoinDisplays();
    customModal.classList.remove('show');
});

/* ========================================================
   4. ORDER SUMMARY & METODE PEMBAYARAN
======================================================== */
var orderModal = document.getElementById('orderModal');
var summaryBackBtn = document.getElementById('summaryBackBtn');
var payNowBtn = document.getElementById('payNowBtn');
var selectedMethod = 'Visa';

btnBuyRecharge.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var dName = detectedTarget ? (detectedTarget.name || '@' + detectedTarget.username) : 'Guest';
    document.getElementById('accountName').textContent = dName;
    document.getElementById('summaryCoins').textContent = Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' Coins';
    document.getElementById('summaryPrice').textContent = '$' + selectedPrice.toFixed(2);
    orderModal.classList.add('show');
});

summaryBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    orderModal.classList.remove('show');
});

document.querySelectorAll('.payment-choice-sm').forEach(function(opt){
    opt.addEventListener('click', function(){
        document.querySelectorAll('.payment-choice-sm').forEach(o => {
            o.classList.remove('selected');
            o.querySelector('b').textContent = '';
        });
        opt.classList.add('selected');
        opt.querySelector('b').textContent = '✓';
        selectedMethod = opt.getAttribute('data-method');
    });
});

/* ========================================================
   5. ANIMASI LOADER & SUKSES
======================================================== */
var loaderModal = document.getElementById('loaderModal');
var successModal = document.getElementById('successModal');
var countdownTimer = document.getElementById('countdownTimer');
var historyStore = [];

payNowBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    orderModal.classList.remove('show');
    loaderModal.classList.add('show');

    var secs = 3;
    countdownTimer.textContent = '00:03';

    var iv = setInterval(function(){
        secs--;
        countdownTimer.textContent = '00:0' + secs;
        if(secs <= 0){
            clearInterval(iv);
            loaderModal.classList.remove('show');

            document.getElementById('successCoinsText').textContent = Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' Coins';
            
            /* Tampilkan Foto Profil & Username Target di Pop-up Sukses */
            var sAvatar = document.getElementById('successTargetAvatar');
            var sName = document.getElementById('successTargetName');
            var sUname = document.getElementById('successTargetUsername');

            if(detectedTarget){
                sAvatar.src = detectedTarget.avatar || 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
                sName.textContent = detectedTarget.name || detectedTarget.username;
                sUname.textContent = '@' + detectedTarget.username;
            } else {
                sAvatar.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
                sName.textContent = 'TikTok Account';
                sUname.textContent = '@tiktok';
            }
            sAvatar.onerror = function(){
                this.src = 'https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/020/964/382/original/tiktok-circle-icon-for-web-design-free-png.png';
            };

            successModal.classList.add('show');

            historyStore.unshift({
                user: detectedTarget ? ('@' + detectedTarget.username) : 'Guest',
                coins: Number(selectedCoins).toLocaleString('en-US'),
                price: selectedPrice.toFixed(2),
                method: selectedMethod,
                time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})
            });
        }
    }, 1000);
});

function clearAccountAfterSuccess(){
    successModal.classList.remove('show');
    resetTarget();
    targetUsernameInput.focus();
}

document.getElementById('goBackBtn').addEventListener('click', clearAccountAfterSuccess);

/* ========================================================
   6. RIWAYAT TRANSAKSI
======================================================== */
var menuRiwayat = document.getElementById('menuRiwayat');
var historyModal = document.getElementById('historyModal');
var historyBackBtn = document.getElementById('historyBackBtn');
var historyList = document.getElementById('historyList');

menuRiwayat.addEventListener('click', function(){
    menuDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    if(historyStore.length === 0){
        historyList.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:20px 0;">Belum ada riwayat transaksi.</div>';
    } else {
        historyList.innerHTML = historyStore.map(function(h){
            return '<div style="background:#f8f9fa;border-radius:6px;padding:6px;margin-bottom:5px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'+
                '<div>'+
                    '<b>' + h.user + '</b>'+
                    '<div style="font-size:8.5px;color:#777;">' + h.method + ' • ' + h.time + ' WIB</div>'+
                '</div>'+
                '<div style="text-align:right;">'+
                    '<b style="color:var(--primary);">+' + h.coins + '</b>'+
                    '<div style="font-size:8.5px;color:#333;">$' + h.price + '</div>'+
                '</div>'+
            '</div>';
        }).join('');
    }
    historyModal.classList.add('show');
});

historyBackBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    historyModal.classList.remove('show');
});
</script>
